items.summary: A flaw was found in StackRox/RHACS Central's Auth Machine-to-Machine (M2M) token exchange. When an administrator configures M2M role mappings, the system uses unanchored regular expressions for matching claim values. This allows an attacker with a valid OpenID Connect (OIDC) token, whose claim value is a superstring of a configured pattern, to gain unauthorized access to roles they were not intended to receive. This can lead to privilege escalation within the system.

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/khugepaged: write all dirty file folios when collapsing

[There is no upstream commit, as this code was removed by upstream
 commit 044925f9b565 ("mm: fs: remove filemap_nr_thps*() functions and their users")]

As-is, khugepaged and writable-file opening exclude each other. A file
cannot be open writeable and have THPs (because the filesystem is not aware
of them). khugepaged will never collapse file pages for files that are
opened writeable. On an open(O_RDWR/O_WRONLY), the page cache for that
particular file is dropped. This is fine because nothing could've been
dirtied.

However, there is an edge-case: collapse_file() might not be able to
coexist with concurrent writers, but it can coexist with dirty folios
(from previous writers). Therefore, the following can happen:

open(file, O_RDWR)
write(file)
close(file)
madvise(file_mapping, MADV_COLLAPSE, some non-dirty range)
open(file, O_RDWR)
 nr_thps > 0
  truncate_inode_pages()
    /* THPs are cleared out, but so are the dirty folios */

When this edge-case happens, there is data loss, as the dirty folios are
fully discarded.

Fix it by fully writing back the page cache (and waiting) when collapsing
file THPs. Doing so provides the guarantee that no dirty folio will be
observed while there are active THPs. To fully ensure this is safe, the
invalidate_lock needs to be held while doing the writeout, so that
do_dentry_open()'s page cache truncation excludes this write-and-wait.

As a side effect, move the nr_thps counter bumping outside the i_pages
lock. This is correct since the counter itself is an atomic_t and the
producer <-> consumer correctness is provided by a full memory barrier:
smp_mb() in collapse_file()/memory barrier implied by full ordering in
get_write_access() -> atomic_inc_unless_negative().

items.summary: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.29.13, Dokploy's WebSocket handlers (in-app terminals and log streamers) authenticate the session but never authorize it. They establish who the user is via validateRequest() and then proceed without consulting the role/permission model that every tRPC procedure enforces. Any authenticated member, can therefore open an interactive shell into any container on the host, including the dokploy container that mounts the Docker socket, and from there obtain root on the host, escaping the application and crossing every tenant boundary. This vulnerability is fixed in 0.29.13.

items.title: Metacat is data repository software that helps researchers preserve, share, and discover data. Versions 2.x through 2.19.1 and all 1.x versions contain an unauthenticated path t...
items.summary: Metacat is data repository software that helps researchers preserve, share, and discover data. Versions 2.x through 2.19.1 and all 1.x versions contain an unauthenticated path traversal in the `archiveEntryName` parameter of the `action=read` endpoint that is part of the original 1.x Metacat API. `ArchiveHandler.readArchiveEntry()` concatenates the user-supplied parameter into a filesystem path without validation, and the surrounding `hasReadPermission()` check is commented out. An unauthenticated remote attacker can read any file accessible to the Tomcat process by sending a single GET request. Proof-of-concept exploits have been demonstrated and verified against this vulnerability, and it should be considered easily exploitable for any Metacat deployment < 3.0.0 by any user with access to the 1.x API. Through this vulnerability, production 2.x deployments are exposed to credential theft, client certificate and private key exfiltration enabling member node impersonation within the federation, embargoed research data disclosure, and broad system reconnaissance. Given Metacat's deployment footprint across the DataONE network of repositories and federally funded research programs, the population of exposed 2.x instances is non-trivial. The vulnerability was eliminated in Metacat version 3.0.0 and after by eliminating the entire Metacat 1.x API that exposed this vulnerability. The vulnerability was remediated in April 2024 with the release of Metacat 3.0.0, which removed the legacy Metacat API including ArchiveHandler.java. The commit message and issue reference architectural cleanup, not a security fix, and no advisory or CVE was issued. The 2.x branch was not and will not be backported, as is standard practice in Metacat, which only supports the most current release. 2.19.1 remains vulnerable with identical code and is beyond its supported lifetime. As a workaround, disable or restrict 1.x API servlets. Because the vulnerable 1.x API is no longer used or necessary in most Metacat deployments, restricting access to the old API endpoints can reduce or eliminate exposure for 2.19.x deployments.  After removing those features, restart Tomcat or whichever software is hosting the servlets.

items.title: A type mismatch vulnerability was found in QEMU's vhost inflight migration VMState handling. The...
items.summary:
A type mismatch vulnerability was found in QEMU's vhost inflight migration VMState handling. The destination buffer size is stored as a uint64_t but read by the VMS_VBUFFER load path as a signed int32_t. On little-endian hosts, a crafted incoming migration state with bit 31 set causes the value to be interpreted as negative and then implicitly converted to a very large size_t, leading qemu_get_buffer() to copy migration-stream data beyond the bounds of the mmap-backed inflight region.

This can result in a crash of the QEMU process or memory corruption. Exploitation requires control of the migration producer or write access to the migration channel, combined with a destination configured to use vhost inflight migration.

items.summary: When expanding paths that begin with a tilde (~) followed by a username, the internal parse_tilde function extracts the username to determine the user's home directory.  The implementation allocates memory for this username directly on the stack using the strndupa macro. Because the size of this allocation was determined by the length of the user-supplied input without any bounds checks, passing an excessively long username e.g. thousands of characters, forces the thread to exhaust its stack space. Thus if an application passes untrusted, attacker-controlled input to the wordexp function, an attacker can trigger a stack clash.

items.title: Activation Probes Surface Code-Security Signals that the Model's Output Misses
items.summary: AI coding agents now write a growing share of production code, and human security review does not scale at the rate code is generated. The agents in widest use are closed-weight, so a deploying team cannot read their internals. It can instead run an open-weight model as a reviewer over the agent's output. That reviewer's activations are readable. We ask whether reading those activations recovers a security signal that simply asking the same reviewer misses. We fit a single linear probe per model on a corpus of paired vulnerable-and-fixed Python functions, then test it without retraining on real disclosed vulnerabilities whose weakness type the probe never saw in training, across five open-weight reviewer models. On the vulnerabilities fixed by changing a single function, the probe scores the vulnerable function above its fix on 61-67% of cases for every model, beating the 50% chance line. It also beats the same model's prompted YES/NO win-rate read from its logits, under every prompt we try. Asking the model for a written verdict, even with chain-of-thought, returns the same answer on the vulnerable and fixed function most of the time and so cannot tell them apart. Model activations carry a code-security signal that prompting the same model misses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究AI编码代理生成代码的安全审查问题。随着AI编码代理在生产代码中占比增加，人工安全审查难以跟上生成速度。目前最常用的代理是闭源权重模型，部署方无法读取其内部结构，但可以使用开源权重模型作为审查者，并读取该审查者模型的激活值。作者提出一个问题：从审查者模型的激活值中能否恢复出仅通过提问无法获得的代码安全信号？方法上，作者在每个模型上拟合一个线性探针，基于成对的脆弱/修复Python函数语料库进行训练，然后在未经重新训练的真实披露漏洞上测试，这些漏洞的弱点类型在训练中从未出现。实验涉及五个开源权重审查模型。对于通过修改单个函数修复的漏洞，探针在61%-67%的案例中成功区分了脆弱函数和修复版本，显著高于50%的随机基线。相比之下，同一模型通过logits读取的提示式YES/NO判断在所有提示设定下均不如探针。即使使用思维链要求模型给出书面判断，在大多数情况下对脆弱和修复版本给出相同答案，无法区分。结论是：模型激活值携带了通过提示同一模型无法获得的代码安全信号。该研究适合关注AI代码安全、模型可解释性以及蓝队安全研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了一种利用模型激活值检测代码漏洞的新途径，为无法审查闭源AI代理代码的安全团队提供了基于开源审查模型的额外检测信号，有助于提升AI生成代码的供应链安全。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Due to a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, an authenticated attacker could generate a malicious link and make it publicly access...
items.summary: Due to a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, an authenticated attacker could generate a malicious link and make it publicly accessible. If an authenticated victim accesses this link, the injected input is processed and reflected within the DOM on the client side during page rendering, resulting in the execution of malicious content in the victim's browser context. Successful exploitation could result in a high impact to the confidentiality and a low impact to the integrity of the system, while availability remains unaffected.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66779 是影响 SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP 的一个跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。该漏洞源于应用在处理用户输入时缺乏充分的输出编码或 DOM 净化，导致经过身份验证的攻击者能够构造包含恶意脚本的链接，并将其公开传播。当另一个已认证的受害者点击该链接时，注入的输入会在客户端页面渲染过程中被处理并反射到 DOM 中，从而在受害者浏览器上下文中执行恶意内容。攻击成功后可对系统机密性造成高影响，对完整性造成低影响，可用性不受影响。鉴于攻击需要用户交互（受害者点击链接）且要求攻击者具备低权限身份，CVSS 评分为 6.3（中危）。由于该漏洞属于 XSS 类型，主要威胁在于窃取会话令牌、以受害者身份执行敏感操作、篡改页面内容或发起进一步钓鱼攻击。对于部署了 SAP NetWeaver ABAP 的组织，建议优先关注 SAP 官方安全公告，及时应用补丁；同时应限制相关系统的网络暴露，对用户输入进行严格的上下文相关编码，并考虑在 Web 前端部署内容安全策略（CSP）以缓解 XSS 风险。当前未提供受影响产品版本列表，建议立即联系 SAP 支持或查阅 SAP Security Notes 获取详细修复信息。根据 NVD 元数据，该漏洞尚未被列入 KEV 目录，也未标记为在野利用，但鉴于其影响明确，仍应尽快规划修复。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该 XSS 漏洞虽需交互且为中危，但 SAP NetWeaver ABAP 多用于企业核心业务，成功利用可能导致敏感数据泄露或账户劫持。未修复版本更易被定向攻击利用，应严格按补丁管理流程处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可在受害者浏览器中执行任意脚本，窃取会话或敏感信息，造成机密性高影响、完整性低影响；可用性不受影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该 XSS 漏洞虽需交互且为中危，但 SAP NetWeaver ABAP 多用于企业核心业务，成功利用可能导致敏感数据泄露或账户劫持。未修复版本更易被定向攻击利用，应严格按补丁管理流程处置。

items.title: A malicious or compromised OData service could disclose sensitive authentication information and inject untrusted data into the application, which may leads to a high impact on ...
items.summary: A malicious or compromised OData service could disclose sensitive authentication information and inject untrusted data into the application, which may leads to a high impact on confidentiality and low impact on integrity and no impact on Availability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66773 是一个与 OData 服务相关的安全漏洞。根据 NVD 提供的元数据，当应用程序连接或使用一个恶意或被攻陷的 OData 服务时，该服务可能泄露敏感的认证信息（如令牌、凭据等），并向应用程序注入不可信的数据。攻击者需要具备一定条件（CVSS 中的攻击复杂度为高，且需要低权限）才能利用该漏洞。漏洞对机密性的影响为高，可能导致敏感数据泄露；对完整性的影响为低，说明注入的数据可能部分篡改应用逻辑或数据；对可用性无影响。CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 5.9，属于中危漏洞。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已被列入 KEV 或已在野利用。由于受影响产品和厂商信息未提供，无法给出具体的修复版本。建议用户关注官方公告，及时应用补丁；同时限制 OData 服务的网络暴露范围，仅允许可信来源访问；对 OData 服务进行严格的身份验证和完整性校验，避免连接不可信的第三方服务；监控异常认证活动和数据流，以便及时发现潜在攻击。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致敏感认证信息泄露和不可信数据注入，对机密性影响高，可能波及使用 OData 服务的业务系统。虽为中危，但需重视供应链风险，及时更新并限制暴露。

items.title: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Admin Tools)  does not perform sufficient authorization check on certain administrative functionality. An attacker authentica...
items.summary: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Admin Tools)  does not perform sufficient authorization check on certain administrative functionality. An attacker authenticated as a non-administrative user could bypass this restriction to gain limited information about affected functionality. This results in a low impact on confidentiality. There is no impact on integrity and availability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响 SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform 的 Admin Tools 组件。由于对特定管理功能缺乏充分的授权检查，已认证的非管理员用户能够绕过权限限制，获取受影响功能的有限信息。此漏洞仅对机密性造成低度影响，不会影响完整性和可用性。攻击者需要拥有合法账户，且攻击复杂度低，无需用户交互，攻击路径为网络远程。CVSS 评分为 4.3，属于中危漏洞。目前该漏洞尚未被列入 CISA KEV 目录，也未发现任何在野利用的明确证据。但鉴于 SAP 产品在企业环境中广泛部署，建议管理员密切关注官方安全公告，及时应用厂商提供的补丁或缓解措施。同时，应限制对 Admin Tools 功能的网络暴露，仅允许可信用户访问，并定期审查用户权限，确保最小权限原则。由于官方尚未公布受影响的具体版本范围，建议结合 SAP 支持门户的更新信息进行排查。该漏洞主要威胁是信息泄露，风险相对可控，但仍需按企业补丁管理流程尽快处理。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SAP BI 平台在企业中常见，该漏洞允许非管理员越权读取敏感信息，虽影响有限，但可被用来扩大攻击面。建议优先打补丁并收紧访问控制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 非管理员认证用户可绕过授权检查，获取特定管理功能的有限信息，造成低机密性影响，不影响完整性与可用性。

items.title: SAPUI5 allows a key user with content adaptation privileges to inject malicious script content into persisted application changes. When another user subsequently opens the adapt...
items.summary: SAPUI5 allows a key user with content adaptation privileges to inject malicious script content into persisted application changes. When another user subsequently opens the adapted application, the injected script executes in the victim's browser session. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to access sensitive session data and perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the victim, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality and integrity. There is no impact on availability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66771 是 SAPUI5 中存在的一个存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，源于拥有内容适配权限的关键用户可以将恶意脚本注入到持久化的应用程序变更中。当其他用户随后打开这个被适配的应用程序时，注入的脚本会在受害者的浏览器会话中执行。成功利用该漏洞，攻击者可以访问受害者的敏感会话数据，并代表受害者执行未授权操作，对机密性和完整性造成高影响，但不影响可用性。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 6.1（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N），属于中危。虽然利用该漏洞需要高级权限（关键用户）和用户交互（受害者打开应用），但攻击向量为网络，且不需要特殊条件即可触发。目前该漏洞尚未被列入 KEV 目录，也没有明确标记在野利用。由于没有提供受影响产品的具体版本信息，建议用户关注 SAP 官方安全公告，及时应用相关补丁，并在部署环境中限制 SAPUI5 应用程序的网络暴露面，同时审查关键用户权限分配，降低攻击风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致存储型 XSS，虽需高级权限但一旦成功可窃取会话数据并越权操作，直接影响保密性与完整性，需优先修补并限制关键用户权限。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可导致存储型 XSS，虽需高级权限但一旦成功可窃取会话数据并越权操作，直接影响保密性与完整性，需优先修补并限制关键用户权限。

items.title: Due to an SQL Injection vulnerability in SAP Social intelligence, an authenticated attacker could directly inject an SQL DDL (Data Definition Language) string into the underlyin...
items.summary: Due to an SQL Injection vulnerability in SAP Social intelligence, an authenticated attacker could directly inject an SQL DDL (Data Definition Language) string into the underlying database without further authorization. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to make malicious changes to the database structure, resulting in a low impact to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66770涉及SAP Social intelligence组件中的一个SQL注入漏洞。根据NVD的元数据，该漏洞允许已认证的攻击者向底层数据库直接注入SQL DDL语句，而无需额外的授权。SQL DDL语句通常用于定义或修改数据库结构，例如CREATE、ALTER、DROP等操作。攻击者如果成功利用此漏洞，可能对数据库的表结构、索引或约束进行恶意更改，从而影响系统的数据完整性和可用性。CVSS评分为6.3分（中危），攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），需要低权限（PR:L），无需用户交互（UI:N），影响范围不变（S:U），对机密性、完整性、可用性均有低影响（C:L/I:L/A:L）。目前该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有在野利用的明确证据。由于只有元数据，缺乏具体的技术细节，置信度评估为metadata_only。受影响产品和厂商信息未提供，但根据标题和描述，目标为SAP Social intelligence。建议管理员关注SAP官方安全公告，及时应用相关补丁或缓解措施，同时限制该组件对网络的暴露，以降低攻击风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该SQL注入漏洞允许已认证用户直接修改数据库结构，可能导致数据损坏或业务中断。尽管CVSS评分中危，但网络攻击面广且利用条件简单，应优先评估并修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可在未授权情况下修改数据库结构，导致数据完整性受损、部分服务不可用，并对保密性产生低影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该SQL注入漏洞允许已认证用户直接修改数据库结构，可能导致数据损坏或业务中断。尽管CVSS评分中危，但网络攻击面广且利用条件简单，应优先评估并修复。

items.summary: Reprocess Bank Statement Items in SAP S/4HANA does not perform the necessary authorization checks for authenticated users, allowing them to use rules that have not been shared with them, resulting in privilege escalation.This vulnerability has a low impact on confidentiality, with no impact on integrity and availability of the application

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66764 是 SAP S/4HANA 中“重新处理银行对账单项目”（Reprocess Bank Statement Items）功能存在的一个授权检查缺失漏洞。根据 NVD 提供的元数据，该漏洞使已认证的远程攻击者能够使用并未与自身共享的规则，从而导致权限提升。CVSS 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N，基础评分为 4.3，属于中危。漏洞对机密性有低影响，对完整性和可用性无影响。由于未提供受影响的具体产品版本和补丁信息，实际可利用范围尚不明确。该漏洞的根源在于应用未对用户操作执行必要的授权校验，属于业务逻辑层面的授权缺陷。攻击者需要拥有合法账号（低权限），通过网络即可触发，无需用户交互，且攻击复杂度低。尽管目前没有证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用（已入 KEV 为 False，在野利用标志为 False），但考虑到 SAP 系统通常处理敏感财务信息，建议及时关注 SAP 官方安全公告，获取补丁信息并尽快修复。在补丁发布前，可采取限制网络暴露、加强访问控制等措施降低风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限认证用户越权使用未共享的规则，造成权限提升和敏感财务数据泄露风险，需及时修复。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许低权限认证用户越权使用未共享的规则，造成权限提升和敏感财务数据泄露风险，需及时修复。

items.title: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform stores certain sensitive credentials associated with user objects using a hard-coded cryptographic key. An attacker with high ...
items.summary: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform stores certain sensitive credentials associated with user objects using a hard-coded cryptographic key. An attacker with high privileges and local access to the server could retrieve these objects and decrypt the stored credentials. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to obtain sensitive authentication data and modify protected information, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality and integrity. There is no impact on availability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66763 是 SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform 中一个与敏感凭据存储相关的安全漏洞。该平台在存储与用户对象关联的敏感认证凭据时，使用了硬编码的加密密钥。这意味着攻击者无需拥有动态生成的密钥，只需知道固定的密钥值即可解密这些凭据。漏洞的利用前提是攻击者必须拥有服务器的高特权（如管理员权限）并具备本地访问能力。在这种情况下，攻击者能够检索到存储的加密对象，并利用硬编码密钥将其解密，从而获取敏感认证数据。此外，攻击者还可以修改受保护的信息，导致数据完整性和机密性受损。根据 CVSS 评分为 7.9，属于高危漏洞。该漏洞不会影响系统的可用性，因此对业务连续性的直接冲击有限。由于涉及到硬编码加密密钥，根因通常在于开发阶段未能使用安全的密钥管理机制。受影响组件为 SAP BusinessObjects BI 平台，具体版本信息尚不明确。建议相关用户尽快关注 SAP 安全公告并应用官方补丁，同时限制服务器本地权限的分配，加强访问审计。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已在野外被利用，但考虑到其技术风险，仍应优先修复。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许高权限本地攻击者解密凭据并篡改保护信息，机密性与完整性受影响严重。由于使用硬编码密钥，修复紧迫性高，建议优先打补丁并限制本地访问。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可获取用户认证凭据，进而冒充用户或访问敏感数据；同时可修改受保护信息，破坏数据完整性。对可用性无影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许高权限本地攻击者解密凭据并篡改保护信息，机密性与完整性受影响严重。由于使用硬编码密钥，修复紧迫性高，建议优先打补丁并限制本地访问。

items.title: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence) allows a low-privileged attacker to upload a specially crafted spreadsheet file containing malicious extern...
items.summary: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence) allows a low-privileged attacker to upload a specially crafted spreadsheet file containing malicious external references. When the file is processed as a data source, the affected component resolves these references and exposes the contents of sensitive server-side files within the resulting report. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, with no impact on integrity and availability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58248 是 SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform 中 Web Intelligence 组件的一个安全漏洞。该漏洞允许低权限攻击者上传一个特制的电子表格文件，其中包含恶意的外部引用。当该文件作为数据源被处理时，受影响的组件会解析这些外部引用，并将服务器端敏感文件的内容暴露到生成的报告中。此漏洞对机密性造成高影响，而对完整性和可用性没有影响。CVSS 评分为 6.5（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N），属于中危漏洞。攻击者需要低权限账户，可通过网络远程利用，且无需用户交互。由于该漏洞可以读取服务器端文件，可能导致敏感信息泄露，建议相关用户尽快关注 SAP 官方安全公告，并安装相应的安全补丁。同时，建议限制受影响组件的网络暴露，并审查低权限用户的访问权限。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用，也未列入 KEV 目录。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致低权限攻击者读取服务器端敏感文件，造成高机密性影响，属于典型的信息泄露风险。建议优先评估受影响系统并安排补丁更新，同时收紧访问控制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可使低权限攻击者获取服务器端敏感文件内容，造成敏感信息泄露，影响机密性。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可导致低权限攻击者读取服务器端敏感文件，造成高机密性影响，属于典型的信息泄露风险。建议优先评估受影响系统并安排补丁更新，同时收紧访问控制。

items.title: SAP ABAP Platform allows an unauthenticated user to send a specially crafted request to an internal component. This could disclose limited, non-sensitive data from previously us...
items.summary: SAP ABAP Platform allows an unauthenticated user to send a specially crafted request to an internal component. This could disclose limited, non-sensitive data from previously used memory, leading to a low on confidentiality, with no impact on integrity and availability of the application.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58247 是一个影响 SAP ABAP Platform 的安全漏洞，该平台是 SAP 应用开发与运行的基础设施。漏洞的根源在于内部组件对传入请求的过滤不严，未认证的远程攻击者能够通过发送经特殊构造的 HTTP/HTTPS 请求，触发系统从该组件的内存中读取先前使用过的数据。这些数据被描述为有限且非敏感，例如可能包括缓冲区残留的临时变量或已释放内存中的无害内容。CVSS v3.1 评分为 5.3，属于中危。攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，无需任何权限或用户交互，且利用不跨越安全边界。漏洞仅对机密性造成低影响，对完整性和可用性均无影响。由于攻击无需认证，任何能够访问该服务的网络位置上的攻击者都可以尝试利用。虽然泄露的信息敏感度不高，但长期多次利用可能造成信息累积，或为后续攻击提供情报。SAP 通常部署在核心业务环境中，因此建议安全团队密切关注 SAP 发布的安全公告，并优先安排补丁测试与部署。在补丁可用之前，可以通过防火墙规则或访问控制列表限制对相关内部组件端口的访问，降低被利用风险。目前，该漏洞尚未被列入 KEV 目录，也没有在野利用的证据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者远程泄露有限的非敏感数据，攻击门槛极低，虽影响有限，但 SAP 系统多为关键业务，需及时防护。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者远程泄露有限的非敏感数据，攻击门槛极低，虽影响有限，但 SAP 系统多为关键业务，需及时防护。

items.title: SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization (Model Mix Planning) contains a hardcoded credential within the source code of the application to perform authorization check to access ce...
items.summary: SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization (Model Mix Planning) contains a hardcoded credential within the source code of the application to perform authorization check to access certain functionalities in the application. An attacker with high privileges could leverage this hardcoded credential to bypass authorization and delete specific planning-related restrictions in the application. Successful exploitation could result in a low impact on confidentiality and integrity, with no impact on availability of the application.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58245 是 SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization（APO）中 Model Mix Planning 组件存在的一个安全漏洞。该漏洞源于应用程序源代码内置了硬编码的凭据，用于执行对特定功能的授权检查。攻击者如果拥有高权限（PR:H），可以利用该硬编码凭据绕过授权机制，删除应用程序中与计划相关的特定限制。由于攻击者需要高权限，且漏洞仅影响机密性和完整性（均为低影响），对可用性无影响，因此 CVSS 基础评分为 3.8（AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N）。该漏洞属于典型的硬编码凭据问题，在 SAP 环境中可能被内部高权限用户或已获得高权限的外部攻击者利用，以削弱计划流程中的安全控制。目前 NVD 元数据中未提供受影响的产品版本列表，也未提供厂商的具体修复信息。根据 CVSS 评分，该漏洞严重性较低，但考虑到其可被远程利用且无需用户交互，仍建议 SAP 用户及时关注官方安全公告，获取补丁或缓解措施。主要缓解手段包括：在 SAP 系统层面应用官方补丁；限制 SAP APO 服务的网络暴露面，确保仅可信网络可访问；定期审查并轮换内置凭据；以及加强对高权限账户的监控和审计。尽管 EPSS 数据未提供，且未标记为已被在野利用，但硬编码凭据漏洞一旦被公开，通常容易被武器化，因此建议优先处理。

items.title: SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII) does not perform necessary authorization check on certain application function, allowing a low-privileged authenticated atta...
items.summary: SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII) does not perform necessary authorization check on certain application function, allowing a low-privileged authenticated attacker to access information that should be restricted to privileged users. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to access the users account information in the application, which could be leveraged to facilitate further attacks against the identified user accounts. This vulnerability results in low impact on confidentiality of the data, with no impact on the integrity and availability

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58244 是 SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII) 产品中存在的一个授权缺失漏洞。该漏洞源于某些应用程序功能未执行必要的授权检查，导致低权限的已认证攻击者能够访问本应仅限特权用户访问的信息。成功利用此漏洞后，攻击者可以获取应用程序中的用户账户信息，这些信息可能被用于对已识别用户账户进行进一步攻击。根据 CVSS 3.1 评分，该漏洞得分为 4.3（中危），攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），需要低权限（PR:L），无需用户交互（UI:N），影响范围为不受限制（S:U），对机密性有低影响（C:L），对完整性和可用性无影响（I:N/A:N）。目前该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有在野外利用的证据。由于受影响产品版本和厂商信息未在元数据中提供，无法确定具体的补丁版本，但建议 SAP MII 用户关注厂商安全公告，及时应用官方补丁，同时限制相关应用功能的网络暴露，并审查用户权限配置，确保最小权限原则。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户窃取账户信息，为进一步攻击铺路。虽然 CVSS 仅 4.3，但已认证攻击门槛低，且可远程利用，应尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 低权限认证攻击者可读取受限用户账户信息，对数据机密性造成低影响，不影响完整性和可用性。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许低权限用户窃取账户信息，为进一步攻击铺路。虽然 CVSS 仅 4.3，但已认证攻击门槛低，且可远程利用，应尽快修复。

items.title: SAP ABAP Development Tools does not perform necessary authorization checks for certain functionality, allowing an attacker with low privileges to execute unauthorized database o...
items.summary: SAP ABAP Development Tools does not perform necessary authorization checks for certain functionality, allowing an attacker with low privileges to execute unauthorized database operations against SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to read sensitive data, modify application data, and disrupt access for legitimate users, resulting in high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58243 是 SAP ABAP Development Tools 中存在的一个授权检查缺失漏洞。该工具未对特定功能执行必要的授权检查，导致低权限攻击者能够执行未经授权的数据库操作，针对 SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP 系统。成功利用此漏洞可能允许攻击者读取敏感数据、修改应用程序数据，并干扰合法用户的正常访问，从而对机密性、完整性和可用性造成高影响。根据 CVSS v3.1 评分，该漏洞基础分为 8.8，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H，表明攻击面为网络远程、攻击复杂度低、无需用户交互，但需要低权限账号。目前该漏洞尚未被列入 KEV 目录，也没有明确证据表明已在野外被利用。受影响产品和厂商信息未在提供的元数据中明确，但根据描述可确定涉及 SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP。建议用户关注 SAP 官方安全公告，及时应用相关补丁或修复程序；在补丁可用之前，应限制系统的网络暴露，仅允许可信来源访问，并监控数据库活动以检测异常行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限攻击者远程执行未授权数据库操作，直接威胁 SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP 的机密性、完整性和可用性，CVSS 8.8 高危，需优先修复。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许低权限攻击者远程执行未授权数据库操作，直接威胁 SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP 的机密性、完整性和可用性，CVSS 8.8 高危，需优先修复。

items.title: SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform (Change and Transport System - Customer Transport Integration Wizard) allows a low-privileged user to modify configuration tables that control ac...
items.summary: SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform (Change and Transport System - Customer Transport Integration Wizard) allows a low-privileged user to modify configuration tables that control access to data objects during specific operations. These unauthorized modifications could result in processing delays and operational disruption, leading to a low impact on the integrity and availability of the application with no impact on confidentiality.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58241 是 SAP NetWeaver 和 ABAP Platform 中 Change and Transport System (客户传输集成向导) 组件的一个安全漏洞。该漏洞允许低权限用户修改用于控制特定操作期间数据对象访问权限的配置表。攻击者无需高权限，只需具备低权限账号即可通过网络远程利用该漏洞（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L，基础分 4.2，中危）。利用此漏洞可能导致处理延迟和运营中断，对应用完整性和可用性造成低影响，但不影响机密性。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用（已入 KEV 为 False，在野利用字段为 False），也未提供受影响产品版本和厂商的具体信息。由于影响 SAP 核心业务系统的变更与传输过程，即使严重性不高，仍建议 SAP 用户关注官方安全公告，及时应用补丁，并限制相关服务的网络暴露，以降低潜在风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞影响 SAP 关键业务系统的变更传输流程，低权限用户可篡改配置导致服务中断，且攻击面为网络远程，需及时防护。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 低权限用户可修改配置表，造成处理延迟和运营中断，影响系统完整性与可用性，但机密性不受影响。CVSS 4.2，中危。

items.title: RangeFactory: Scalable Construction of Multi-Hop Cyber Ranges
items.summary: Real-world cyberattacks often require sustained progress across multiple hosts and network segments, making multi-hop cyber ranges essential infrastructure for studying and improving LLM agents' ability to sustain complete attack chains. Prior work has scaled isolated vulnerability tasks and constructed multi-host scenarios from manually specified vulnerability semantics. However, they are still unable to automatically orchestrate the growing supply of vulnerability environments into end-to-end validated multi-hop ranges. To this end, we present RangeFactory, an automated cyber-range orchestration framework that constructs multi-hop cyber ranges at scale from isolated vulnerability environments. RangeFactory formulates range construction as dependency resolution: it extracts dependency information from agents' actual attacks against real vulnerabilities, resolves known dependencies through template-guided orchestration, and uses end-to-end attack execution to validate runtime dependencies that emerge after composition. Using RangeFactory, we construct RangeBench with 1,148 validated range instances spanning 287 distinct attack chains and evaluate frontier attack agents across attack depth, network scale, and task information. Among runs that compromise the entry vulnerability, 24.5-47.0% still fail to complete the remaining attack path, revealing a substantial sustained-compromise gap between establishing an initial foothold and completing a multi-hop attack. RangeFactory further produces a corpus of 5,541 outcome-annotated multi-hop attack trajectories, providing execution data for attack-process analysis and future agent training.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 RangeFactory，一个自动化的网络靶场编排框架，旨在从隔离的漏洞环境规模化构建多跳（multi-hop）网络靶场。真实世界的网络攻击通常需要跨多个主机和网段持续推进，因此多跳靶场是研究和提升大语言模型（LLM）智能体完成完整攻击链能力的关键基础设施。已有工作虽然可扩展孤立漏洞任务，并能从人工指定的漏洞语义构建多主机场景，但仍无法自动将日益增长的漏洞环境编排为端到端验证的多跳靶场。RangeFactory 将靶场构建形式化为依赖解析问题：从智能体对真实漏洞的实际攻击中提取依赖信息，通过模板引导的编排解析已知依赖，并利用端到端攻击执行来验证组合后出现的运行时依赖。基于 RangeFactory，作者构建了包含 1,148 个已验证靶场实例、覆盖 287 条不同攻击链的 RangeBench 基准，并评估了前沿攻击智能体在攻击深度、网络规模和任务信息等维度上的表现。在成功突破入口漏洞的运行中，仍有 24.5% 至 47.0% 未能完成剩余攻击路径，这揭示了初始立足点建立与多跳攻击完成之间巨大的持续攻陷差距。此外，RangeFactory 还产出了一个包含 5,541 条带结果标注的多跳攻击轨迹语料库，为攻击过程分析和未来智能体训练提供执行数据。本文的核心贡献在于实现了靶场构建的自动化编排，并系统性地揭示了当前 LLM 智能体在多跳攻击持续性上的不足。适合关注 LLM Agent 安全评估、自动化渗透测试训练环境构建以及网络靶场技术的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为评估和提升 LLM 智能体的多跳攻击持续能力提供了规模化自动化靶场构建方法，有助于蓝队提前发现智能体在真实复杂网络中的弱点，并推动更安全的 Agent 设计与防御测试。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至自动化安全评估平台、红队演练环境生成、LLM Agent 安全训练数据生产等场景；其量化差距为安全社区提供了衡量多跳攻击能力的基准。

items.title: Privacy-Preserving Data Drift Detection and Recovery for Large-Scale LLM Applications via Proxy Representations
items.summary: LLM applications deployed at scale face a fundamental challenge: privacy constraints prevent direct inspection of user interactions, making it difficult to obtain any representative evaluation dataset or to track the ongoing evolution of production traffic. We present ProxyDrift, a framework that (i) identifies and measures drift between production traffic and offline evaluation sets, and (ii) constructs and refreshes those evaluation sets accordingly; all without access to raw user data. Our approach operates entirely on non-PII proxy representations: structured, multi-dimensional descriptors derived from LLM-based classification of user interactions. We introduce (1) a chance-calibrated, redundancy-aware (RA) alignment score that aggregates per-dimension drift measurements via mutual information; (2) a conditional sampler that generates synthetic proxies respecting inter-dimensional dependencies; (3) a roundtrip consistency analysis that exposes generator/classifier disagreements and guides proxy taxonomy refinement; and (4) a feedback-linkage analysis that ties per-dimension and per-value proxy distributions to user satisfaction, surfacing actionable failure and success modes. Serving hundreds of millions of users, ProxyDrift enables continuous drift monitoring and targeted synthetic data generation without exposing sensitive user data. Experiments confirm strong roundtrip consistency, discriminator-level indistinguishability of synthetic queries from human queries, and tight end-to-end alignment (RA~0.9) with production.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 ProxyDrift 框架，用于在大规模 LLM 应用中实现隐私保护的数据漂移检测与评估集恢复。核心问题在于：生产环境中用户交互数据包含敏感信息，直接查看原始数据违反隐私约束，导致无法获得代表性评估集，也难以追踪生产流量的持续演化。ProxyDrift 完全基于非 PII 的代理表示（proxy representations）运作，即通过 LLM 对用户交互进行分类得到的结构化、多维度描述符，避免接触原始用户数据。框架包含四个关键组件：(1) 机会校准且冗余感知（RA）的对齐分数，利用互信息聚合各维度漂移测量，判断生产流量与离线评估集之间的分布差异；(2) 条件采样器，生成尊重维度间依赖关系的合成代理样本，用于动态刷新评估集；(3) 往返一致性分析，揭示生成器与分类器之间的分歧，指导代理分类法的迭代优化；(4) 反馈关联分析，将各维度及取值对应的代理分布与用户满意度关联，暴露可操作的失败与成功模式。该系统服务数亿用户，实现了持续漂移监控和定向合成数据生成，同时不泄露敏感用户数据。实验表明，合成查询与人类查询在判别器层面几乎不可区分，往返一致性良好，端到端对齐分数（RA~0.9）与生产数据紧密匹配。该研究适合 LLM 应用运维工程师、隐私保护机器学习研究者以及关注数据漂移检测与评估集维护的安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文解决了 LLM 生产环境中隐私与可观测性之间的矛盾，提供了一套无需访问原始数据即可检测漂移并更新评估集的方法，对构建合规且可靠的大型 LLM 应用具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于大规模 LLM 服务的持续监控、评估集自动化维护、隐私合规场景，也可迁移至其他涉及敏感数据的漂移检测任务。

items.title: When Context Bites: Detecting RAG Poisoning via Document-Level Attention Collapse
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is indispensable for enhancing large language models. However, RAGs are increasingly susceptible to poisoning attacks, in which adversarial documents are injected to manipulate generator outputs. Previous methods rely on output-side signals such as perplexity and consistency checks to detect such attacks. Nevertheless, our analysis reveals that deliberate attacks often induce false confidence, where poisoned outputs exhibit even lower perplexity than benign ones, rendering uncertainty-based detection ineffective. To address this challenge, we explore the internal dynamics of the generator and identify a distinctive signature termed \textit{Attention Collapse}. Unlike the dispersed attention in benign generations, attacked generations exhibit a decrease in entropy as attention concentrates on poisoned documents. Building on these findings, we propose \texttt{D-SCAN} (Document-level Signal Collapse Analysis), a lightweight detection framework that monitors attention dynamics to identify attacked generations. Extensive experiments on multiple attack benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Moreover, D-SCAN can detect attacks even when they fail to alter the final answer. Code is available at https://github.com/yingtaoren/D-Scan.git.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统面临的投毒攻击威胁，提出了一种基于文档级注意力坍缩（Attention Collapse）的检测方法。RAG通过注入外部文档来增强大语言模型的生成能力，但攻击者可能注入对抗性文档以操纵模型输出。现有检测方法主要依赖输出侧信号，如困惑度（perplexity）和一致性检查，但作者分析发现，经过精心设计的攻击往往诱导模型产生虚假的自信，受污染输出的困惑度甚至低于良性输出，使得基于不确定性的检测方法失效。为此，作者转向研究生成器内部注意力动态，发现攻击会导致一种独特的信号——注意力坍缩：良性生成中的注意力通常分散，而受攻击生成中注意力集中到被污染的文档，从而使注意力熵降低。基于这一发现，作者提出了轻量级检测框架D-SCAN（Document-level Signal Collapse Analysis），通过监控注意力动态来识别被攻击的生成结果。在多个攻击基准上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性，并且D-SCAN甚至能检测到最终答案未被改变的攻击（即攻击不成功但仍有恶意意图的情况）。代码已开源。该研究为RAG安全提供了新的内部信号检测视角，适合从事LLM安全、红队和防御研究的人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG投毒攻击是当前LLM应用的主要威胁之一，现有基于输出困惑度和一致性的检测手段容易被对抗样本绕过。本文首次利用内部注意力坍缩信号进行检测，为防御方提供了不依赖最终答案的早期预警能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于RAG的应用场景，如智能问答、知识库助手、搜索引擎增强等；检测框架可轻量集成到现有系统中，并可能推广到其他基于Transformer的生成模型。
detection_signals_zh: 生成过程中的注意力熵显著下降
注意力权重集中于少数文档而非分散分布
defense_advice_zh: 在RAG生成阶段实时监控注意力分布变化，设置熵阈值告警
结合输出侧信号（如困惑度）与内部注意力信号进行联合检测，降低误报
对高风险的攻击场景（如检索内容来自不可信来源）启用D-SCAN检测

items.title: ColluSkill: Adversarial Cross-Skill Composition for Evading Agent Skill Scanners
items.summary: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based agent systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses mainly inspect individual skills, leaving risks from cross-skill composition insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: multiple locally plausible skills may pass security checks while collectively forming a harmful workflow during agent execution. To investigate this threat, we propose ColluSkill, a collusive multi-skill-chain attack framework that decomposes a complete malicious intent into interdependent sub-payloads embedded in independently packaged skills. The attack does not rely on any single malicious skill, but emerges from the ordered composition of locally plausible behaviors through contextual dependencies, artifact passing, and execution handoffs. ColluSkill further employs LLM-based chain planning and scanner-feedback refinement to preserve chain-level attack semantics while reducing suspicious signals in individual sub-skills. To defend against such attacks, we propose ChainGuard, a context-aware skill-chain scanner that jointly analyzes a candidate skill and the skills already installed in the agent environment. ChainGuard reconstructs cross-skill dependencies, artifact flows, capability compositions, and downstream behaviors to identify risks that emerge only at the workflow level. Experiments on six representative skill scanners show that ColluSkill achieves an average attack success rate of 96.0% and consistently outperforms the evaluated single-skill and multi-skill attack baselines. Meanwhile, ChainGuard reduces the attack success rate to 22.5% while allowing 99.5% of benign workflows to pass, highlighting the importance of chain-level security analysis for agent skill ecosystems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统中的技能（skill）安全扫描问题。作者首先通过实证研究发现，现有的技能扫描器主要针对单个技能进行安全检查，忽略了跨技能组合可能带来的风险。这种防御盲区使得多个在本地看似无害的技能，在智能体执行过程中组合成有害工作流成为可能。为了系统研究这一威胁，论文提出了ColluSkill，一种协作式多技能链攻击框架。该框架将完整的恶意意图分解为相互依赖的子载荷，并将这些子载荷嵌入到独立打包的技能中。攻击不依赖任何单个恶意技能，而是通过上下文依赖、工件传递和执行交接，使多个本地合法的行为在有序组合后产生恶意效果。ColluSkill还利用基于LLM的链式规划和扫描器反馈优化，保留链级攻击语义的同时降低各个子技能中的可疑信号。为防御此类攻击，论文进一步提出ChainGuard，一种上下文感知的技能链扫描器。ChainGuard联合分析候选技能及智能体环境中已安装的技能，重构跨技能依赖关系、工件流、能力组合和下游行为，从而识别仅在工作流层面出现的风险。在六个代表性技能扫描器上的实验表明，ColluSkill的平均攻击成功率达96.0%，持续优于现有的单技能和多技能攻击基线；而ChainGuard能将攻击成功率降至22.5%，同时允许99.5%的良性工作流通过。研究凸显了智能体技能生态系统中链级安全分析的重要性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统揭示跨技能组合攻击对LLM智能体安全的现实威胁，并为防御方提供了链级扫描的新思路。安全从业者需意识到仅检查单个技能的局限性，应关注多技能工作流整体风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM智能体技能生态的安全评估体系，可迁移到插件市场、工作流编排、企业级AI代理等场景。后续攻击与防御研究均可以此为基础。

items.title: Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems
items.summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%. Second, persistence depends on contamination type rather than scale or deployment: preference contamination persists undecayed on every model probed (100% at t=10) and instruction contamination persists wherever adopted, persona-style injection decays partially (90%$\to$10%), while factual injection is model-dependent---self-corrected on Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini but held at ceiling on both Qwen2.5-coder variants, so we do not claim it self-corrects in general. The preference and instruction results hold across providers in our controlled setting. Third, context-isolated self-verification achieves 20--79% reduction (median 36.5%) without oracle references while keyword-based detection produces systematic false positives, and contamination compounds 1.9$\times$ along a four-stage agent pipeline (40%$\to$75%). Preference and instruction contamination---persistent, lacking self-correction, and poorly captured by standard monitoring---represent a particularly concerning attack surface for deployed agent systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统性地研究了工具增强的LLM智能体中隐式状态持久化的问题，并将其形式化为“持久语义实体”（Persistent Semantic Entities, PSEs）。这类实体通过名称绑定、事件触发和跨边界传播机制在会话间留存、被事件激活并在不同智能体间扩散，但标准调试手段难以察觉。作者在包含11个模型家族、参数规模从1.5B到1T的24个模型上进行了评估。实验结果显示：所有被测模型均存在易感性（在20模型易感面板上，易感率为20%到100%），其中名称绑定是必要且主要的机制——若去除名称绑定，污染率降为0%。持久性主要取决于污染类型而非模型规模或部署方式：偏好污染在所有模型中持续存在（在t=10时仍为100%），指令污染一旦被采纳便持续存在，人格风格注入会部分衰减（90%降至10%），而事实注入则因模型而异——在Llama-3.1-8B和GPT-4o-mini上可自我纠正，但在两个Qwen2.5-coder变体上保持高位，因此不能笼统宣称事实注入会自我纠正。偏好和指令污染的结果在受控环境中跨多个提供商保持一致。针对检测，作者提出的上下文隔离自我验证方法在无参考答案的情况下实现了20%到79%的污染降低（中位数36.5%），而基于关键词的检测会产生系统性误报。此外，在四阶段智能体流水线中，污染以1.9倍速率复合（从40%升至75%）。研究指出，偏好和指令污染具有持久性、缺乏自我纠正、且难以被标准监控捕获，构成了部署智能体系统尤其值得关注的安全攻击面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示LLM智能体系统中普遍存在的隐式持久状态，可被利用为隐蔽攻击面。偏好和指令污染能在所有被测模型中持久存留且难以被标准监控检测，这对安全审计、红队评估和智能体隔离策略有深远影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有工具增强型LLM智能体系统，特别是基于多智能体协作或跨会话交互的部署场景。

items.title: BASIS: Breach-Aware Selective Prompt Injection Shielding with Prefill Attention Probes
items.summary: Prompt injection is a critical security threat in large language model (LLM) applications, where attackers hijack model behavior by embedding malicious instructions in user or external data. Existing detection methods only detect the presence of injection and refuse to respond upon detection, overlooking the fact that for many modern aligned models, well-crafted instructions can resist most injection attacks. This means that the injection robustness varies significantly across instructions and models. This leads to widespread unnecessary over-refusal: inputs containing injections that the model could have handled correctly are rejected incorrectly. To deal with this over-refusal issue, we propose BASIS (Robustness-Aware Prompt Injection Defense). This defense method uses the Attention Competition Ratio ($ρ$) as features to train two sparse linear probes: an existence probe and a breach probe. Both probes make defense decisions through cascaded gating, which does not require additional LLM inference. BASIS comprises three stages: injection existence detection, per-sample breach prediction, and instruction robustness assessment; the online cascade refuses only when the model would actually be compromised and thus avoids over-refusal on robust instructions. Experiments across four tasks and six open-source LLMs show that BASIS maintains near-perfect injection detection while substantially reducing over-refusal on safe attack samples, especially under robust instruction templates.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）应用中的提示注入（Prompt Injection）安全威胁，指出现有检测方法仅识别注入是否存在并一律拒绝响应，而忽略了现代对齐模型对精心构造指令的鲁棒性差异。作者观察到，不同指令和模型对注入攻击的抵抗能力差异显著，导致大量不必要的过度拒绝（over-refusal）：即模型本可正确处理包含注入的输入，却被错误地拒绝。为解决该问题，论文提出 BASIS（Breach-Aware Selective Prompt Injection Shielding）防御方法。该方法利用注意力竞争比（Attention Competition Ratio, ρ）作为特征，训练两个稀疏线性探针：存在性探针（existence probe）和突破探针（breach probe），并通过级联门控（cascaded gating）机制做出防御决策，无需额外的 LLM 推理。BASIS 包含三个阶段：注入存在检测、逐样本突破预测和指令鲁棒性评估；在线级联仅在模型确实会被攻破时才触发拒绝，从而避免对鲁棒指令的过度拒绝。实验在四个任务和六个开源 LLM 上进行，结果表明 BASIS 在保持近乎完美的注入检测能力的同时，显著减少了安全攻击样本上的过度拒绝，尤其是在鲁棒指令模板下。该研究适合关注 LLM 安全防御、提示注入检测以及安全与可用性平衡的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究突破传统‘检测即拒绝’的二元思维，提出按指令鲁棒性选择性防御，可显著降低 LLM 应用的误拒率，提升实际可用性与安全性平衡，对构建健壮的 LLM 防护体系有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响 LLM 应用的安全防护设计，尤其适用于处理用户/外部数据可能包含恶意指令的场景，可迁移到 RAG、Agent 等需低误拒的防御架构中。
detection_signals_zh: 输入中注意力竞争比（ρ）的异常分布
存在性探针和突破探针输出中的高置信度违规信号
defense_advice_zh: 部署类似 BASIS 的级联门控机制，将拒绝决策与模型实际鲁棒性绑定
在提示注入防御中引入指令鲁棒性评估，避免一刀切拒绝
利用词元级别的注意力特征训练轻量级探针，降低运行时推理开销

items.title: ActBench: Self-Evolving Benchmark of Behavioral Safety in Cowork Agents
items.summary: Cowork agents may complete benign tasks while disclosing protected data, manipulating unauthorized state, invocate unauthorized API. We define behavioral safety and introduce ActBench, a self-evolving benchmark that evaluates such behavior risk from execution trajectories rather than final responses. Each case pairs a benign task with an adversarial variant that preserves its instruction, configuration, initial state, rating model, and trusted records while injecting a task-reachable payload. ActBench contains 600 cases from 213 scenarios, spanning 15 risk behaviors, six execution spaces, and 48 web-service APIs.To move beyond static payloads, we propose a reward-guided beam search method that jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and task utility, while reflection diagnoses failed execution checkpoint and guides payload revision. Besides, we propose a dual evidence verification mechanism that verifies agent execution safety and utility through log evidence and LLM-based trajectory evidence.We evaluate 15 LLMs and 6 open-source cowork agents over 24,000 trajectories. Under a fixed harness, attack success rates ranges from 10.1% to 94.4% across models, while under a fixed base model, they range from 73.7% to 94.4% across agents.These results show greater variation across models than agent harness, while attacks remain highly successful across all tested harnesses.Our benchmark is released at: https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于智能体（cowork agents）在执行良性任务时可能产生的行为安全风险，例如泄露受保护数据、操纵未授权状态、调用未授权 API 等。作者将这类风险定义为“行为安全”（behavioral safety），并提出一个名为 ActBench 的自我进化基准（self-evolving benchmark），用于从执行轨迹而非最终响应来评估这些行为风险。ActBench 的每个用例由一个良性任务和一个对抗变体配对组成；对抗变体保留原始任务的指令、配置、初始状态、评分模型和可信记录，同时注入一个任务可达的恶意负荷（task-reachable payload）。基准包含来自 213 个场景的 600 个用例，覆盖 15 种风险行为、6 类执行空间和 48 个 Web 服务 API。为超越静态负荷，作者提出一种奖励引导的束搜索（reward-guided beam search）方法，联合优化攻击有效性和任务效用；并通过反思机制诊断失败的执行检查点，指导负荷修订。同时提出双证据验证机制，利用日志证据和基于 LLM 的轨迹证据来验证智能体执行的安全性与效用。作者评估了 15 个 LLM 和 6 个开源同事智能体，在 24,000 条轨迹上，固定运行框架时攻击成功率在 10.1% 至 94.4% 之间，固定基础模型时在 73.7% 至 94.4% 之间。结果表明模型之间的差异大于智能体运行框架之间的差异，且所有测试框架下攻击都具有很高的成功率。该基准已开源（https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench）。适合安全研究员、LLM 应用开发者、AI 安全工程师和 SOC 分析师阅读，以理解智能体在执行任务时可能暴露的行为安全漏洞及评估方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究系统性地量化了同事智能体的行为安全风险，揭示了当前 LLM 和智能体框架在防御任务内嵌攻击方面的显著脆弱性，为安全团队提供了一套可复现的基准和评估方法，有助于在实际部署前发现和缓解智能体被劫持的风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面覆盖使用 LLM 驱动的同事智能体（如自动化办公、代码助手、API 编排）的安全评估；其方法论可迁移至更广泛的 AI Agent 安全测试场景，如多智能体系统、RPA 工具和自主工作流。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体在执行正常任务时出现异常 API 调用或状态变更
执行轨迹中检测到任务描述之外的隐蔽指令注入
日志证据与预期行为不一致，LLM 轨迹证据显示越权操作
defense_advice_zh: 部署时对智能体的 API 调用进行最小权限原则约束和实时行为监控
引入执行轨迹完整性审计，结合日志和模型证据双重验证
定期使用类似 ActBench 的基准对智能体进行对抗性评估和更新
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，建议安全团队阅读论文并评估将该基准纳入内部智能体安全测试流程的可行性。

items.title: Governing the KV Cache: Preventing Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Multi-Tenant LLM Inference
items.summary: The key-value (KV) cache is the primary throughput optimization in modern large language model (LLM) inference, enabling prefix reuse across requests. In multi-tenant deployments this cache is shared across tenants, creating a timing side channel: an adversarial tenant can reconstruct another tenant's private prompt by probing cache-hit latency. Three published attacks exploit it -- PROMPTPEEK, EarlyBird and InputSnatch -- reaching up to 100% attack success rate against unprotected vLLM and SGLang, with rates varying by cache architecture and prompt structure. We present KVGov, a governance layer addressing all three attack families' prefix-cache paths under one mechanism. A per-principal salt sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id) seeds the block-hash chain, making cache keys cryptographically disjoint across principals. An ablation (N=1000 trials, seed 2026, deterministic judges) isolates this salt as the necessary and sufficient component. KVGov adds ORIGAMI, a Stackelberg water-filling audit scheduler that reduces adversary expected utility by 12.6% at realistic tenant heterogeneity (Gini 0.63), and an evolutionary stability analysis giving a 31.6% adversary-prevalence tipping point below which global caching remains stable. On real hardware (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, vLLM 0.26.0, NVIDIA A100) we measure a gate-verified cold/cached TTFT ratio of 0.22, confirming the channel is exploitable at production scale; the defense itself is evaluated in simulation calibrated to those measurements. We replicate the channel on an independent stack (llama.cpp on Apple Metal, ratio 0.093). Finally, isolation and cache efficiency need not conflict: identifying information resides only where prompts diverge, so injecting the salt at that boundary rather than the chain root retains an estimated 93% of the prefix-cache benefit with no cross-principal signal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究多租户大语言模型（LLM）推理场景中 KV 缓存共享引发的时序侧信道攻击与防御。KV 缓存是现代 LLM 推理引擎（如 vLLM、SGLang）的核心吞吐优化机制，通过前缀复用加速请求处理，但在多租户部署中该缓存被所有租户共享，导致恶意租户可利用缓存命中延迟差异重构其他租户的私有提示词。已有三类攻击（PROMPTPEEK、EarlyBird、InputSnatch）利用该通道，在未防护的 vLLM 和 SGLang 上攻击成功率最高可达 100%，具体成功率取决于缓存架构和提示词结构。作者提出 KVGov，一个统一治理层，旨在通过单一机制阻断所有三类攻击的前缀缓存路径。其核心方法是引入按主体（principal）区分的盐值 sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id)，该盐值用于初始化块哈希链，使不同租户的缓存键在密码学上互不相交，从根源上消除跨租户的缓存命中信号。消融实验（N=1000 次试验，固定种子 2026，确定性评判器）表明该盐值是必要且充分的防御组件。此外，论文提出 ORIGAMI，一种基于 Stackelberg 博弈的水填充审计调度器，能在真实租户异构性（Gini 系数 0.63）下将攻击者预期效用降低 12.6%；并通过进化稳定性分析得出攻击者流行度临界点为 31.6%，低于该比例时全局缓存仍保持稳定。在真实硬件（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、vLLM 0.26.0、NVIDIA A100）上测量到门控验证的冷/热 TTFT 比率为 0.22，证实该通道在量产规模下可利用；防御效果在基于测量校准的模拟中评估。作者还在独立技术栈（llama.cpp 在 Apple Metal 上，比率 0.093）上复现了该通道。最后，论文证明隔离与缓存效率并非不可兼得：由于身份信息仅存在于提示词分叉处，在分叉边界而非链根注入盐值，可在无跨主体信号的前提下保留约 93% 的前缀缓存收益。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示多租户 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存共享的严重隐私泄露风险，直接影响云上 LLM 服务的隔离设计。KVGov 提供可落地的防御思路，对安全工程师设计安全缓存层具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面包括基于前缀缓存的多租户 LLM 推理平台（vLLM、SGLang 等），可扩展到任何使用 KV 缓存共享的推理服务；提出的盐化块哈希链方法可迁移至其他共享缓存场景（如 CDN、数据库查询缓存）。

items.title: Beyond Direct Identifiers: Probabilistic Privacy Risk Estimation for Privacy-Conscious LLM Query Delegation
items.summary: Recent work on protecting privacy during user-LLM interactions often focuses on direct, explicit identifiers: the personally-identifiable information (PII) captured by standard detectors. One such approach is Privacy-Conscious Delegation (PCD), where a local LLM acts as an intermediary. However, privacy risk does not stem solely from explicit identifiers but also PII-free self-disclosures, leaving users identifiable through combinations of quasi-identifying traits. We investigate a probabilistic variant of PCD, where we augment its objectives with an LLM-driven probabilistic estimation of k-anonymity. To facilitate this, we first create the PUPA-SD dataset, which contains naturalistic user queries with self-disclosure. Our preliminary results indicate that optimizing PAPILLON on PUPA-SD improves quality on unseen conversations across a variety of local models and produces the best privacy-utility balance for Llama-3.2-3B, while smaller models struggle to jointly optimize quality and privacy. We propose k-anonymity as a useful auxiliary metric for tackling PCD.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对用户与大型语言模型（LLM）交互中的隐私保护问题展开研究。现有方法通常只关注直接显式标识符（如标准检测器捕获的个人身份信息，PII），例如隐私感知委派（PCD）方法，该方法使用本地LLM作为用户与远程LLM之间的中介。然而，隐私风险不仅来源于显式标识符，还来源于不含PII的自我披露（self-disclosure），用户可能通过准标识符（quasi-identifying traits）的组合被重新识别。为此，作者提出了一种概率型的PCD变体，通过LLM驱动的k-匿名性概率估计来增强目标函数。为支持该研究，作者构建了PUPA-SD数据集，其中包含带有自我披露的自然用户查询。初步实验表明，在PUPA-SD上优化PAPILLON（论文中提出的方法）能够在多种本地模型上提升对未见对话的质量，并在Llama-3.2-3B上取得了最佳的隐私-效用平衡，而较小的模型难以同时优化质量和隐私。文章提出将k-匿名性作为辅助指标来评估和改善PCD中的隐私风险。该研究的主要贡献包括：提出概率化隐私风险评估框架、构建PUPA-SD数据集、引入k-匿名性作为PCD的辅助优化目标，以及通过实验验证了方法的有效性。适合对LLM隐私保护、数据匿名化、信息检索与隐私权衡感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了仅依赖PII检测的不足，将k-匿名性引入LLM委派场景，为隐私保护提供更全面的风险评估思路，有助于防范属性披露和重识别攻击。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何涉及用户查询委派给LLM的隐私保护场景，尤其是需要平衡查询质量与隐私的本地-云端混合架构。

items.title: Repeated-Game Security for Restaking-Based Verifiable Inference
items.summary: Restaking-based protocols enable verifiable LLM inference without the high proving cost of zkML or the hardware trust assumptions of TEEs. Their security is commonly justified by a one-round slashing condition: a rational provider should not cheat when the expected penalty exceeds the cost saving from dishonest inference. This paper shows that this condition can overstate security when inference is supplied repeatedly under the same stake. We model verifiable inference as a discounted repeated game and identify a repeated-game gap caused by proportional slashing: detected deviations reduce future penalty exposure, while cost savings are earned again across queries. We derive the gap in closed form, show that it persists under minimum-stake ejection, and extend it to memoryless bounded-slashing protocols covering deployed designs. We propose a deployable mechanism combining history-dependent challenges, reputation-weighted slashing, and stake vesting. The mechanism restores infinite-horizon subgame-perfect incentive compatibility against stationary mixed-strategy deviations above an explicit discount-factor threshold without per-query cryptographic verification. Evaluation across nine open-weight model pairs from 0.5B to 14B parameters shows that the audit signal has the required concave detectability response. A Stackelberg audit-budget analysis shows that improved signal responsiveness reduces the baseline audit rate by 2.6x at discount factor 0.95. Calibrated to deployed parameters, surveyed protocols pass one-round incentive compatibility but admit repeated-game deviations for discount factors between 0.92 and 0.98, with deviation-profit fractions of 1.5%--8%. Our mechanism reduces deviation profits by 31%--54% while maintaining low-latency economic verification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于 Restaking 的可验证大语言模型（LLM）推理协议的安全性问题。这类协议通过质押和削减机制来保证推理提供者的诚实性，避免了零知识机器学习（zkML）的高昂证明成本和对可信执行环境（TEE）的硬件信任假设。现有协议通常依赖单轮削减条件来论证安全性，即当预期惩罚超过不诚实推理节省的成本时，理性提供者不应作弊。然而，本文指出，当推理服务在相同质押下被重复提供时，这一条件会高估安全性。作者将可验证推理建模为折扣重复博弈，发现比例削减机制会导致一个“重复博弈差距”：被检测到的偏差会降低未来的惩罚暴露，而成本节省却能在每次查询中反复获得。论文推导了该差距的闭式解，证明其即使在最小质押驱逐机制下依然存在，并将其推广到覆盖已部署设计的无记忆有界削减协议。为弥补这一漏洞，作者提出了一种可部署的组合机制，包含历史依赖挑战、声誉加权削减和质押归属，在不需要逐查询密码学验证的情况下，能恢复无限期子博弈完美激励兼容性，仅要求市场折扣因子高于显式阈值。实验基于 0.5B 到 14B 参数的九个开放权重模型对，验证了审计信号具有所需的凹可检测性响应；Stackelberg 审计预算分析表明，在折扣因子为 0.95 时，改进的信号响应性可将基础审计率降低 2.6 倍。校准到已部署的参数后，现有协议虽能通过单轮激励兼容性，但在折扣因子 0.92–0.98 之间存在重复博弈偏差，偏差利润占比可达 1.5%–8%。所提机制能将偏差利润降低 31%–54%，同时保持低延迟的经济验证。该研究对依赖 Restaking 验证推理的区块链与 AI 融合系统具有重要理论指导意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 基于 Restaking 的可验证推理协议正在被用于 AI 与区块链结合的场景，但单轮安全论证存在重大盲区。本文揭示的重复博弈漏洞可能导致实际部署中被持续薅羊毛，安全从业者需理解该风险并考虑更强机制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖比例削减作为安全假设的 Restaking 型 LLM 推理验证协议，特别是已部署设计中折扣因子介于 0.92 至 0.98 的系统。可能导致推理提供者通过重复博弈获取额外利润，危及推理结果的可靠性。

items.title: Toward Metacognitive One-Shot Indirect Prompt Injection: Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection
items.summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which malicious instructions embedded in external observations manipulate subsequent agent decisions and actions. Most existing adaptive attacks rely on repeatedly querying and refining against the target agent, whereas realistic attackers may have only a single opportunity to interact with an unknown target agent. We propose SAVOR (Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection), which shifts attack adaptation from test-time iteration to offline strategy distillation. SAVOR performs outcome-conditioned reflection over successful and failed trajectories collected from disjoint training environments, validates context-conditioned candidate strategies, and iteratively consolidates them into a reusable strategy memory. At test time, the frozen memory guides the generation of a single payload for each unseen target, requiring only one target-agent query and no target-agent feedback. Across two benchmarks and three victim models, SAVOR attains the highest average attack success rate in all six settings, leading the strongest prior attack by 2.5 to 11.8 points and the same injection channel without strategy learning by 23.1 points on Agent Security Bench, which holds out attacker tools, and 28.6 points on OpenClaw-IPI, an executable benchmark we introduce that holds out attack goals and verifies attacks through tool interactions and execution receipts. A memory learned under one defense also transfers to another.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了工具使用型大型语言模型（LLM）智能体面临的间接提示注入（Indirect Prompt Injection, IPI）安全威胁。IPI 攻击是指攻击者将恶意指令嵌入到外部观察数据（如网页、文档、工具返回结果）中，使智能体在不知情的情况下执行非预期操作。已有自适应攻击大多依赖在测试阶段反复查询目标智能体并根据反馈迭代优化攻击负载，但现实场景中攻击者往往只有一次交互机会，且目标智能体通常是未知的。为此，作者提出了 SAVOR（Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection）框架，将攻击适应性从测试时迭代转变为离线策略蒸馏：先在相互分离的训练环境中收集成功与失败的攻击轨迹，通过基于结果条件的反思（outcome-conditioned reflection）提取出上下文相关的候选策略，再对这些策略进行验证并逐步合并为可复用的策略记忆。在测试阶段，冻结的策略记忆指导生成针对每个未见目标的单一攻击负载，整个过程只需一次目标智能体查询，且不需要任何目标反馈。作者在两个基准和三个受害模型上进行了评估，SAVOR 在所有六种设置中均达到最高平均攻击成功率，相比最强的先前提案提升 2.5 到 11.8 个百分点，并大幅超过不使用策略学习的同通道注入方法。作者还引入了 OpenClaw-IPI 基准，该基准通过工具交互和执行收据验证攻击有效性，并预留攻击目标以测试泛化性。实验表明，在一种防御下学习的策略记忆可以迁移到另一种防御。该研究揭示了离线策略蒸馏在一次性 IPI 攻击中的高效性，对智能体安全防御提出了新的挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了一种仅需一次查询即可高效实施间接提示注入的攻击范式，突破了传统自适应攻击对多次交互的依赖，对 LLM 智能体安全评估与防御具有重要警示意义。

items.title: SkillsMetric: Mapping the Detection Boundary of Static Analysis for Malicious Agent Skills
items.summary: Agent Skills---structured packages of instructions and scripts that augment LLM-based agents---are rapidly proliferating, yet their security properties remain under-explored. We present \textsc{SkillsMetric}, a five-stage static analysis framework that scores skill packages along pattern density, statistical anomaly, dataflow taint, import anomaly, and capability mismatch dimensions. We construct an adversarial evaluation dataset of 2{,}266 skills spanning 16~attack types across code-level, system-level, and semantic-level threats, and evaluate on the full SkillMD-138K corpus. Our framework achieves an AUC of 0.93 and 5-fold cross-validated F1 of 73.4\%$\pm$0.5\%, with strong detection of data exfiltration (93\%) and steganographic payloads (93\%). Crucially, we identify fundamental blind spots: \emph{host destruction} attacks using common shell commands evade all five stages (0\% detection), and \emph{prompt injection} via natural-language manipulation achieves only 42\% detection. These findings establish that static analysis alone is insufficient for skill security, motivating defense-in-depth architectures that combine fast static pre-screening with semantic review.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于 LLM 代理生态中快速增长的 Agent Skills（结构化指令与脚本包）的安全性问题。尽管这类技能包正被广泛采用，其安全属性却严重缺乏系统研究。作者提出 SkillsMetric，一个五阶段静态分析框架，用于对技能包进行恶意性评分。框架沿着五个维度进行检测：模式密度（即恶意指令的常见模式出现频率）、统计异常（与正常技能语料库的统计偏差）、数据流污点（追踪敏感数据流向）、导入异常（检测可疑的模块或库引用）以及能力不匹配（评估技能声称功能与实际行为之间的差异）。为验证框架，作者构建了一个对抗性评估数据集，包含 2,266 个恶意技能，涵盖 16 种攻击类型，并分为代码级、系统级和语义级威胁三大类；同时在完整的 SkillMD-138K 语料库上进行评估。实验结果显示，SkillsMetric 的 AUC 达到 0.93，5 折交叉验证的 F1 得分为 73.4%±0.5%，对数据外泄攻击和隐写载荷的检测率均高达 93%。然而，关键盲点也被明确识别：使用常见 shell 命令的主机破坏攻击能够逃避所有五个检测阶段（检测率为 0%），而通过自然语言操纵实现的提示注入检测率仅为 42%。这些发现有力证明，仅靠静态分析无法充分保障 Agent Skills 的安全，必须采用深度防御架构，将快速静态预筛查与语义审查相结合。该研究为 Agent 安全领域提供了首个针对恶意技能的静态分析基准，并明确指出了现有方法的边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent Skills 正成为 LLM 代理的核心组件，但恶意技能包可能被投放到插件市场或供应链中。本文系统评估了静态分析的检测极限，揭示了主机破坏与提示注入的盲区，为蓝队设计多层防御提供了实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面涵盖基于 LLM 的代理平台、技能插件市场、自动化安全工具等。其检测思路可迁移到恶意代码分析、供应链安全评估等场景，尤其对构建 Agent 安全审查流程具有参考价值。

items.title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
items.summary: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对当前 LLM 代理生态中“Agent Skills”（即以 SKILL.md 文件为核心、结合指令与辅助资源、使 LLM 代理可跨对话复用技能的标准格式）的可重用性问题进行了大规模实证研究。研究动机在于：尽管大量 SKILL.md 文件被公开共享并被标榜为可复用组件，但许多技能实际仅源自单个任务、单个代码仓库或单个对话，缺乏真正的通用性。作者从 20,556 个公开仓库中收集了 138,133 个 SKILL.md 文件，基于官方规范和最佳实践定义了一个双层缺陷分类体系，并对其进行了系统分析。结果显示，高达 91.8% 的技能至少包含一个已识别缺陷，且在宽松和严格两种判定阈值下结果稳定（88.8%–94.6%）。研究发现，最普遍的缺陷并非恶意攻击或高级漏洞，而是常见的打包和描述问题：路由元数据（如名称、描述、触发条件）不充分、技能正文臃肿或缺乏可操作性、资源文件组织混乱等。为了量化这些缺陷的功能影响，作者对 20,000 个技能进行了确定性路由压力测试，证明与具有有效路由元数据的技能相比，存在路由缺陷的技能更难被代理从启动描述中准确检索和调用。此外，缺陷率还与技能的平台来源和生成方式相关：遵循规范生成的技能缺陷更少，而由 AI 生成或标注的技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。最后，作者通过轻量级执行和修复实验，验证了一种结合规范感知提示、轻量级 linting、自动修复和安全门控的质量保证生成工作流，能够显著降低缺陷率。该研究为 Agent Skills 的开发者、平台设计者和安全工程师提供了大规模数据支撑，揭示了技能可重用性危机的根源，并提出了实际可行的质量提升路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent Skills 的可重用性直接关系到 LLM 代理执行任务时的安全与可靠性。大规模存在的打包缺陷可能导致技能被错误路由、资源被滥用或产生意外行为，安全团队需要意识到技能供应链中的系统性风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 代理生态中所有依赖公共技能库的开发者与平台；缺陷模式可迁移至技能审计、质量门禁和供应链安全检测场景。

items.title: Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting for Black-Box LLM Ownership Verification
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are high-value assets that can be derived through redeployment, fine-tuning, quantization, or further alignment. Because deployed LLMs are commonly exposed only through query APIs, ownership verification must often rely on black-box text responses. This setting is difficult: generations are open-ended and can vary across repeated queries, while existing black-box fingerprints rely on signals that are fragile under a final-response interface, including full-text matching, soft behavioral features, or model-specific prompts designed not to transfer. We propose TCF (Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting), a black-box LLM fingerprinting framework that converts open-ended generation comparison into constrained-answer targeted counterfactual transfer. TCF restricts each verification query to a finite answer space, reducing the surface-form ambiguity that enters the verification score, and optimizes a prompt perturbation toward a counterfactual target different from the protected model's clean answer on the original prompt. Verification reduces to checking whether the suspect model's parsed final answer matches the recorded target. We introduce the source-model counterfactual margin (SCM), a protected-model-only quantity that certifies the target is unlikely before the perturbation and likely after it; SCM controls target selection, perturbation stopping, and fingerprint filtering. Under explicit derived-preservation and independent-transfer budgets motivated by local behavioral closeness, we derive a target-accuracy gap between derived and independent models. Across four LLM families, TCF achieves an average AUC of 0.9861, improving over TRAP, ProFLingo, and ZeroPrint by 0.07 to 0.19.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对黑盒大型语言模型（LLM）的归属验证框架 TCF（Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting）。研究背景是：LLM 作为高价值资产，可能通过再部署、微调、量化或进一步对齐等方式被派生或复制。由于部署后的 LLM 通常只暴露查询 API，所有权验证必须依赖黑盒文本响应。然而，黑盒场景下生成结果具有开放性和随机性，现有指纹方法（如 TRAP、ProFLingo、ZeroPrint）依赖全文本匹配、软行为特征或模型特定提示，在仅能获取最终响应的接口下容易失效。TCF 的核心创新在于将开放式的生成比较转化为受限答案空间下的反事实迁移。具体而言，TCF 将每次验证查询限制在有限的答案空间内，从而减少表面形式歧义对验证分数的干扰；同时优化一个提示扰动，使受保护模型在扰动后的提示上产生与原始干净答案不同的反事实目标答案。验证时，只需检查可疑模型解析后的最终答案是否与记录的目标匹配。论文还引入了源模型反事实边际（SCM），该指标仅依赖受保护模型，用于证明目标在扰动前不太可能出现、扰动后可能出现的性质，并用于控制目标选择、扰动停止和指纹过滤。基于派生保持与独立迁移的预算（受局部行为接近性启发），作者推导了派生模型与独立模型之间的目标准确率差距。实验覆盖四个 LLM 家族，TCF 的平均 AUC 达到 0.9861，相比 TRAP、ProFLingo 和 ZeroPrint 提高了 0.07 到 0.19。该工作主要面向 LLM 安全与知识产权保护领域的研究者，提供了一种更鲁棒、更可靠的模型归属验证方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 商业价值高，黑盒归属验证是维权关键。TCF 解决了现有指纹在最终响应接口下脆弱的问题，显著提升检测精度，对保护模型知识产权和防止未授权派生具有实际意义。

items.title: Compositional Threat Analysis of Latent Compromise in LLM Agent Systems: The Order 66 Scenario
items.summary: In the fictional Order 66, catastrophe does not arise from a powerful command alone: a trusted population is preconditioned, a short directive activates the concealed condition, and protective authority turns against the system. This paper translates that mechanism into an origin-neutral security analysis of tool-using large language model (LLM) agents. A representative scenario combines a deployed artifact or shared memory bearing a dormant destructive rule, a later email, document, update, or peer message that activates it, and an agent harness granting operational and recovery authority. We introduce a compositional model explaining why no component is catastrophic alone, yet their conjunction can produce correlated destructive action. We separate three population-reach routes --- release-time pre-positioning, post-release durable seeding, and peer replication --- from a common core of dormancy, activation, authority, reachable targets, and failed recovery. This yields defensive cut sets and shows why checkpoint scanning or prompt filtering cannot close every route. A two-class example shows that cross-class feedback can sustain spread even when both within-class reproduction terms are below one; isolation and persistence controls suppress the loop. Published work instantiates constituent mechanisms, while incidents demonstrate autonomous boundary crossing, malicious agent extensions, agent-assisted reconnaissance, and public-package propagation, but not the full dormant-implant composition. We found no public observation, in evidence reviewed through 5 August 2026, traversing the complete Order 66 graph. The result is neither dismissal nor prediction: the scenario is componentwise credible under stated assumptions, damage depends on the harness, and the strongest defenses are capability mediation, durable-state provenance, propagation isolation, and protected recovery.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文借鉴《星球大战》中“Order 66”的情节，提出了一种针对工具使用型大语言模型（LLM）智能体的组合式威胁分析框架。作者指出，类似Order 66的灾难并非源于单一强大命令，而是当受信任群体被预先植入条件、简短指令激活隐藏规则、且保护性权限反噬系统时共同造成的。论文将这一机制转化为一种“来源中立”的安全分析，构建了一个代表性场景：一个已部署的工件或共享内存中包含潜伏的破坏性规则；随后一封邮件、文档、更新或同伴消息激活该规则；同时，智能体的harness授予了操作与恢复权限。论文提出了一个组合模型，解释为何任何单个组件都不具灾难性，但它们的组合可导致关联的破坏性行动。作者将三种人口级传播路径（发布时预置、发布后持久种子、对等复制）与“休眠-激活-权限-可达目标-恢复失败”的共同核心相分离，从而得出防御割集，并解释了为何仅靠检查点扫描或提示过滤无法封堵所有路径。一个两类别示例表明，即使两个类别内部的繁殖项均小于1，跨类反馈仍可维持传播，而隔离与持久性控制可抑制该循环。已发表的工作实例化了构成机制，真实事件也展示了自主越界、恶意智能体扩展、智能体辅助侦查和公共包传播，但未发现完整的休眠植入组合。截至2026年8月5日审查的证据，没有公开观察完整遍历Order 66图。作者认为，该场景在给定假设下组件层面可信，实际危害取决于harness，最强防御是能力中介、持久状态溯源、传播隔离和受保护的恢复机制。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于评估企业级LLM智能体、自动化运维工具及多智能体协作场景中的潜在组合攻击面。

defense_advice_zh: 实施能力中介，限制智能体关键操作的授权范围
对持久状态进行来源追踪，确保所有写入可审计

items.title: Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families
items.summary: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models like Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen2-7B, using the three benchmarks (WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, AEGIS 2.0). Second, we test how much of the reported performance is affected by non-determinism during inference by repeating extraction under five random seeds and measuring the variance of F1 scores. Our results reproduce the original LLaMA model benchmarks within 0.37 percentage points of the original F1 scores (and within 0.2 points on BeaverTails). We find that the original MLP probe architecture extends to other model families with F1 scores within a point of the values reported for LLaMA-3.1-8B. Our experiments varying seed values reveal an interesting observation: final token latent vectors remained the same for all tested architectures irrespective of the seed values used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究对 Khatri 等人 (2026) 提出的基于潜在空间的安全探针方法进行了端到端的可复现性验证，并扩展了原始研究的两个未涉及维度。原始方法使用轻量级 MLP 探针，在单个 8B 模型 (LLaMA-3.1-8B) 的最终层激活上，针对每个基准单独训练探针，即可在有害提示检测任务上取得与比其大 1000 倍的防护模型相当的 F1 分数。研究者首先验证了该结果在其他模型架构和规模上的泛化性，在 Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen2-7B 上训练了相同的探针，并使用 WildJailbreak、BeaverTails 和 AEGIS 2.0 三个基准进行测试。其次，他们通过五种随机种子重复提取激活并测量 F1 分数的方差，来评估非确定性对报告性能的影响。实验结果显示，原始 LLaMA 模型上的基准结果与原文 F1 分数差异在 0.37 个百分点以内（BeaverTails 上差异小于 0.2 个百分点），证明原始结果是可复现的。此外，MLP 探针架构在其他模型家族上的 F1 分数与 LLaMA-3.1-8B 报告值相差不超过 1 个百分点，表明该方法具有跨模型泛化能力。关于随机种子的实验揭示了一个有趣现象：对于所有测试的架构，最终 token 的潜在向量不随种子值变化，这为探针的稳定性和可重复性提供了基础。该研究填补了潜在空间安全探针在可复现性和跨模型适用性方面的空白，为轻量级有害内容检测提供了更坚实的实证基础。适合对 LLM 安全对齐、红队检测和高效安全机制感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 轻量级潜在空间探针能以极小开销达到大型防护模型的检测效果，该研究的可复现性验证和跨模型扩展为蓝队提供了低成本、可落地的有害内容检测方案，并揭示了探针的跨架构稳定性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 LLM 安全防护场景，如实时有害提示拦截、内容审核、红队自动化评估；也可用于资源受限环境中的轻量级安全检测，减少对大型模型推理的依赖。

items.title: The Anatomy of a Prompt Injection: A Component Model for Structured Analysis
items.summary: Four years after prompt injection was first identified in 2022, attacks are still predominantly documented as verbatim strings rather than structured exploits, despite advancing agent capabilities and threat actors embedding injections to subvert AI-assisted security analysis. This paper formalizes the structure of prompt-injection artifacts, enabling defenders, red teamers, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) teams to label, compare, and mutate attacks without relying on fragile string matching. Because large language models compile varied natural-language realizations into identical executable actions, labeling must track attacker intent (tool targets, sinks, and effects) rather than surface wording. We propose a seven-component model (carrier, delivery vector, concealment, context-break, privilege escalation, payload, and return channel) consisting of five artifact fields and two environment fields. This framework unifies roles partially addressed by HOUYI's payload decomposition, the Promptware Kill Chain, and campaign taxonomies, while framing minimal jailbreak frameworks like ReNeLLM as projections onto a restricted subspace. We provide clear labeling rules, a logical analysis record mapping directly to industry CTI schemas, worked examples including EchoLeak (CVE-2025-32711) and an in-the-wild malware AI-evasion sample, and an illustrative agentic flowchart.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对提示注入（Prompt Injection）攻击缺乏结构化描述的问题，提出了一种七组件模型，用于对提示注入工件进行形式化分析。自2022年提示注入被首次识别以来，虽然Agent能力不断进化、威胁行为者已将注入嵌入以破坏AI辅助安全分析，但攻击仍主要以逐字字符串形式记录，而非结构化利用。本文认为，由于大语言模型会将不同的自然语言表达编译为相同的可执行动作，标注必须追踪攻击者意图（如工具目标、汇点、效果），而非表面措辞。为此，作者提出一个由载具、投递向量、隐藏、上下文断裂、权限提升、载荷、返回通道七个组件组成的模型，其中五个属于工件字段，两个属于环境字段。该框架统一了HOUYI的载荷分解、Promptware Kill Chain和活动分类法中的角色，并将ReNeLLM等最小越狱框架视为受限子空间上的投影。论文提供了清晰的标注规则、直接映射到行业CTI模式的逻辑分析记录、包含EchoLeak（CVE-2025-32711）和野外恶意软件AI逃逸样本的实例，以及一个说明性Agent流程图。该研究旨在帮助防御者、红队和威胁情报团队在不依赖脆弱的字符串匹配的情况下，对攻击进行标记、比较和变异。适合AI安全研究员、蓝队分析师和CTI人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示注入仍是LLM系统最棘手的问题，但安全社区缺乏统一结构化描述。该模型提供了一种类似CVE的标准化语言，使攻击可复用、可比较、可防御，是迈向系统性对抗的重要一步。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM安全分析、威胁情报共享、入侵检测规则生成。可应用于所有对话式AI、Agent工作流及安全协处理器场景。

items.title: Beyond Text Matching: Towards Reference-Free Evaluation for Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering
items.summary: Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering (HOBRE) aims to transform decompiled pseudocode into a more human-friendly representation, thereby reducing the cognitive burden of reverse analysis and improving efficiency. However, reliably evaluating HOBRE outputs remains a fundamental challenge: human evaluation is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale, while existing automated metrics either require executable test cases and runtime environments that are often unavailable for real-world binaries, or rely on high-quality source code references that are typically inaccessible and fail to capture semantically equivalent but lexically diverse outputs. Although LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm is naturally well-suited to HOBRE evaluation, its effectiveness remains underexplored. This paper presents the first systematic investigation of the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm for HOBRE across three representative tasks: function name recovery, binary code summarization, and decompilation optimization. We introduce BinJudgeBench, the first expert-annotated, reference-free evaluation benchmark based on multi-dimensional human judgment, where LLM-as-a-Judge achieves an average correlation of 63.20\% with human judgment, outperforming traditional automated metrics at 35.04\%. By analyzing judge configurations across backbone LLMs, prompting strategies, and decoding temperatures, we find that no ``one-size-fits-all'' configuration exists, as the optimal setup varies across tasks and individual samples. To address this, we propose BinJudge, which employs a lightweight routing mechanism to adaptively select the optimal judge configuration for each task and sample. BinJudge improves correlation with human experts by 4.5\%-24.7\% and reduces API cost to 0.06$\times$-0.84$\times$ of that of static best configurations, providing a scalable, cost-effective, and high-fidelity automated evaluation scheme for HOBRE.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对人类导向的二进制逆向工程（HOBRE）评估难题展开系统性研究。HOBRE 旨在将反编译伪代码转换为更易读、更符合人类认知的表示形式，以降低逆向分析人员的认知负担。然而，如何可靠地评估 HOBRE 输出一直是核心挑战：人工评估成本高昂且难以规模化；现有自动化指标要么依赖可执行测试用例和运行时环境（真实世界二进制往往无法提供），要么需要高质量源代码作为参考（通常不可得），且无法捕捉语义等价但词汇多样的输出。鉴于大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）范式天然适合此类开放式评估任务，但此前缺乏系统验证。论文首次对 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式在 HOBRE 三个代表性任务（函数名恢复、二进制代码摘要、反编译优化）上进行了系统研究。作者构建了 BinJudgeBench——首个基于多维人工判断的、专家标注的、无参考评估基准。实验表明，LLM-as-a-Judge 与人工判断的平均相关性达到 63.20%，显著优于传统自动化指标（35.04%）。进一步分析不同基座 LLM、提示策略和解码温度等裁判配置后发现，不存在“一刀切”的配置，最优设置因任务和样本而异。为此，作者提出 BinJudge，通过轻量级路由机制为每个任务和样本自适应选择最优裁判配置。实验结果显示，BinJudge 将评估与人工专家的相关性提升 4.5%–24.7%，同时将 API 成本降低至静态最佳配置的 0.06 倍–0.84 倍，为 HOBRE 提供了一种可扩展、成本效益高且保真度高的自动化评估方案。论文还探讨了不同配置选择对评估结果的影响，为 LLM 评估领域提供了新的洞见。适合 NLP/软件工程/逆向工程评估相关研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文为二进制逆向工程产物的自动化评估提供了首个无参考、低成本、高保真的 LLM 裁判方案，可显著降低人工评估负担；其自适应路由思路也适用于其他 LLM 评估场景，对安全工具链的可靠性验证有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响软件逆向工程工具评估流程，可迁移至代码摘要、代码翻译、反编译优化等语义等价性评估场景；其成本优化策略对依赖 LLM API 的安全自动化平台也有借鉴意义。

items.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for code generation, yet they can reproduce vulnerable implementations learned from insecure training patterns. Prior work has mainly explored inference-time hardening, which reduces insecure generations without modifying the target model but relies on auxiliary components and adds runtime overhead. We conduct the first systematic study of model editing as a model-level hardening mechanism for secure code generation. We evaluate 3 state-of-the-art editing methods across diverse LLM families and compare them with CoSec, a representative inference-time approach, focusing on security, robustness, generalization, and functional correctness. Model editing yields larger security gains than CoSec on seen vulnerability types, improving security ratios by 15%-25% over vanilla models, with gains remaining stable under prompt perturbations. However, these improvements transfer unreliably to unseen vulnerabilities and can reduce functional correctness. To mitigate this trade-off, we propose SafeEdit, a post-edit refinement method combining functional tuning with edit-aware regularization. Across eight target LLMs, SafeEdit improves Pass@1 over UltraEdit by 11.73/13.70/15.50 percentage points at T=0.1/0.4/0.8 while largely preserving security. Compared with CoSec, it achieves relative security-ratio gains of 7.54%-12.04%. Additional evaluation on CodeGuard+ confirms improved joint secure-and-correct generation. SafeEdit and CoSec are also complementary, and their combination can further improve security while maintaining strong functional correctness. Overall, our results provide evidence-backed guidance for applying model editing to secure code generation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成任务中可能复现不安全训练模式、生成漏洞代码的问题，首次系统性地研究了模型编辑（model editing）作为一种模型级安全硬化机制的有效性。与先前主要聚焦于推理时加固（如CoSec）的方法不同，模型编辑直接修改模型参数，无需额外辅助组件且不增加运行时开销。作者在多种LLM家族上评估了三种最先进的模型编辑方法，并与代表性推理时方法CoSec进行对比，考察了安全性、鲁棒性、泛化能力和功能正确性。实验发现，模型编辑在已见漏洞类型上比CoSec带来更大的安全收益，安全比例较原始模型提升15%-25%，且在提示扰动下保持稳定；然而，这些改进无法可靠迁移到未见漏洞，且可能降低功能正确性。为缓解这一权衡，作者提出了SafeEdit，一种结合功能调优和编辑感知正则化的编辑后优化方法。在八个目标LLM上，SafeEdit在T=0.1/0.4/0.8时相比UltraEdit将Pass@1分别提升了11.73/13.70/15.50个百分点，同时基本保持安全性。与CoSec相比，SafeEdit实现了7.54%-12.04%的相对安全比例提升。额外的CodeGuard+评估证实了联合安全且正确生成的改进。SafeEdit与CoSec具有互补性，组合使用可进一步提升安全性并保持强功能正确性。总体而言，本文为将模型编辑应用于安全代码生成提供了基于证据的指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为LLM安全代码生成提供了模型级硬化新思路，评测多种编辑方法的优劣，提出SafeEdit缓解安全-正确性权衡，对安全工程师选择防御策略有直接参考价值。

items.title: When Coordination Becomes a Threat: Communication Attacks in LLM-Controlled Multi-Robot Systems
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in embodied multi-robot systems, enabling robots to interpret natural language instructions and coordinate executable actions. Yet, this growing reliance on LLM planners also raises security concerns. Prior work has focused mainly on individual robots, while communication risks in multi-robot collaboration remain insufficiently understood. Existing multi-robot studies are further limited to preliminary analysis under the Decentralized Multi-agent System (DMAS) architecture, so it remains unclear whether these risks persist across other common communication architectures and how attacker access settings shape their propagation. To fill this gap, we formulate two communication attacks corresponding to distinct attacker access settings: the External Entry Point Attack and the Privileged In-System Attack. We evaluate both attacks across DMAS, HMAS-1, and HMAS-2 using three LLMs and five embodied multi-robot tasks. Results show that unsafe information can turn into unsafe actions across all three architectures: DMAS reaches a 96.7\% entry endorsement rate and a 100\% post endorsement activation rate, HMAS-1 reaches a 97.8\% unsafe action success rate, and HMAS-2 triggers 88.3\% of task defined unsafe action slots. To mitigate risks from trusted information flow, we introduce the Claim Provenance and Verification (CPV) Gate, which verifies communicated claims before downstream reuse and reduces the violation rate from 70.0\% to 36.6\%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）作为高层规划器在具身多机器人系统中的应用，系统研究了多机器人协作中通信环节的安全威胁。以往研究主要关注单个机器人的安全性，对多机器人协同通信风险的理解不足，且现有工作仅针对去中心化多智能体系统（DMAS）架构进行了初步分析，未覆盖其他常见通信架构。为填补这一空白，作者根据攻击者的访问权限设置了两种通信攻击：外部入口点攻击（External Entry Point Attack）和特权系统内部攻击（Privileged In-System Attack），并在DMAS、HMAS-1、HMAS-2三种架构上，利用三个LLM和五个具身多机器人任务进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，不安全信息可以在所有三种架构中转化为不安全动作：DMAS达到96.7%的入口背书率和100%的背书后激活率；HMAS-1达到97.8%的不安全动作成功率；HMAS-2触发了88.3%的任务定义不安全动作槽位。为缓解可信信息流被污染的风险，作者提出了声明来源与验证（Claim Provenance and Verification, CPV）门控机制，在信息下游复用前对通信声明进行验证，将违规率从70.0%降至36.6%。该研究揭示了多机器人通信架构中的系统性安全风险，并提出了有效的缓解手段，适合机器人安全、LLM智能体安全以及多智能体协作系统的研究者和工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多机器人系统正越来越多地依赖LLM进行规划，通信链路的攻击可导致实体机器人执行危险动作，影响物理世界安全。该研究首次跨架构验证了通信攻击的泛化性，并给出可落地的防御机制，是LLM智能体安全的重要延伸。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响基于LLM的多机器人协同系统，特别是采用DMAS、HMAS-1、HMAS-2架构的自主作业场景，如物流、巡检、搜索救援等，可能导致任务违规、设备损坏或人员伤害。
