items.title: LoRAScan: Detecting Backdoor Prompts in Low-Rank Adapters for Large Language Models via Down-Projection Activation Spikes
items.summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization and distribution of large language models through compact adapters. However, untrusted adapters introduce a supply-chain threat: a backdoored adapter can cause a model to generate harmful content, malicious code, political propaganda, or covert advertisements when an input contains a hidden trigger. Adapter-agnostic defenses merge the adapter with the base model, which dilutes backdoor signals and reduces detection performance. Existing adapter-aware methods do not address how to safely use a potentially backdoored adapter. Instead, they either train a defensive adapter to repair a backdoored base model, addressing the inverse problem rather than securing the adapter itself, or rely on a classifier that flags the entire adapter as suspicious and requires separate mitigation. These methods overlook the distinct latent-space signatures produced by trigger-bearing inputs in backdoored adapters. We introduce LoRAScan, the first adapter-aware defense that detects and rejects trigger-bearing inputs at inference time without modifying adapter parameters. Our key observation is that a small subset of LoRA insertion sites, approximately 5%, remains stable across clean inputs but exhibits highly concentrated spikes in LoRA down-projection activations when a trigger is present. LoRAScan identifies these low-variance insertion sites before model deployment and monitors them during inference. Across standard LLM backdoor benchmarks, LoRAScan rejects approximately 98.49 of malicious inputs with a small error rate on clean inputs, outperforming existing defenses across diverse evaluation settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 LoRAScan 的新型防御方法，用于检测大型语言模型（LLM）低秩适配器（LoRA）中的后门提示。LoRA 是一种高效的模型微调技术，通过引入小型适配器模块来降低计算成本，但也带来了供应链安全风险：不可信的适配器可能包含后门，使得模型在遇到特定触发词时生成有害内容、恶意代码、政治宣传或隐蔽广告。现有防御方法主要分为两类：一类是适配器无关的防御，将适配器与基础模型合并，这会稀释后门信号并降低检测性能；另一类是适配器感知的方法，但要么训练一个防御性适配器来修复被后门化的基础模型（关注的是对抗问题而非保护适配器本身），要么使用分类器将整个适配器标记为可疑，需要单独处理。这些方法都忽略了后门适配器中触发输入产生的不同潜在空间特征。LoRAScan 是第一个在推理时检测并拒绝触发输入、且不修改适配器参数的适配器感知防御方法。其核心观察是：大约 5% 的 LoRA 插入位点在干净输入下保持稳定，但在触发词存在时，其下投影激活会表现出高度集中的尖峰。LoRAScan 在模型部署前识别这些低方差插入位点，并在推理过程中监控它们。在标准 LLM 后门基准测试中，LoRAScan 能拒绝约 98.49% 的恶意输入，同时在干净输入上保持较低的误报率，在多种评估设置下均优于现有防御方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LoRA 适配器的供应链攻击是当前 LLM 安全的重要风险，LoRAScan 提供了首个不修改适配器参数即可在推理时拒绝后门输入的方案，对依赖第三方适配器的企业 LLM 部署具有直接防护意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于使用 LoRA 适配器进行模型定制的场景，尤其涉及不可信的模型市场或开源适配器下载；可迁移到其他参数高效微调（如 Prefix-Tuning）的后门检测。
detection_signals_zh: LoRA 下投影激活在特定插入位点上出现集中尖峰
触发输入导致低方差插入位点的激活异常偏离基线
defense_advice_zh: 在部署 LoRA 适配器前，使用 LoRAScan 识别低方差插入位点并建立监控
在推理阶段实时监控这些位点的激活值，拒绝超过阈值的输入
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估 LoRAScan 在自身 LoRA 适配器场景中的适用性，并关注其误报率与性能开销。

items.title: Retrieval-Constrained Policy Optimization for Attack Technique Extraction from Cyber Threat Intelligence
items.summary: Mapping cyber threat intelligence (CTI) text to MITRE ATT&CK techniques is essential for structured threat analysis, yet manual annotation is costly and does not scale. The ATT&CK taxonomy comprises several hundred attack techniques, and a single CTI passage may describe multiple techniques, making accurate and complete extraction challenging. Existing automated approaches fall short in different ways: multi-label classifiers struggle with severe class imbalance and the large label space, while LLM-based methods--retrieval pipelines and fine-tuned generators--optimize token-level objectives that treat technique annotation as sequence generation rather than set prediction, lacking direct supervision on whether the predicted technique set is correct and complete. We propose TTP-R1, a two-stage framework that combines retrieval-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards (RLVR). A hybrid retriever first narrows the large label space to a candidate set, and a fine-tuned LLM learns to select the correct techniques. We then apply Group Relative Policy Optimization with a decomposed reward that directly supervises the precision, recall, and output format of the predicted technique set. Across four CTI benchmarks, TTP-R1 achieves the best average F1, improving sub-technique-level F1 by 7.4 percentage points over Claude Sonnet 4.5 with retrieval augmentation, while running 28x faster when served as an 8B-parameter model on a single GPU.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 TTP-R1 的两阶段框架，用于从网络威胁情报（CTI）文本中自动提取 MITRE ATT&CK 攻击技术。手动标注 ATT&CK 技术成本高昂且难以扩展，而 ATT&CK 分类体系包含数百种技术，单条 CTI 文本可能涉及多种技术，导致准确且完整的提取充满挑战。现有的自动化方法存在不足：多标签分类器受严重类别不平衡和大标签空间困扰；基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法（如检索增强流水线或微调生成器）优化的是 token 级目标，将技术标注视为序列生成而非集合预测，缺乏对预测技术集合正确性和完整性的直接监督。TTP-R1 结合了检索增强的监督微调（SFT）与基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。其混合检索器首先将庞大的标签空间缩小为候选集，然后微调 LLM 学习从中选择正确技术；随后应用分组相对策略优化（GRPO），使用分解奖励直接监督预测技术集合的精确率、召回率和输出格式。在四个 CTI 基准上，TTP-R1 取得了最佳平均 F1，子技术级 F1 相比使用检索增强的 Claude Sonnet 4.5 提升 7.4 个百分点，且以 8B 参数模型在单 GPU 上服务时运行速度快 28 倍。该研究聚焦于利用可验证奖励的强化学习来提升结构化威胁情报抽取的准确性与效率。适合 LLM 安全应用、威胁情报自动化及安全运营研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了 CTI 到 ATT&CK 自动映射这一安全运营刚需，其两阶段 RLVR 方法显著提升抽取精度与速度，为蓝队自动化威胁分析提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于威胁情报平台、SIEM/SOAR 中的自动化攻击技术标注、告警富化及报告生成；其强化学习+可验证奖励的训练范式也可能迁移到其他结构化信息抽取任务。

items.title: SynChain: Inducing Computer-Use Agent Systems to Construct Their Own Attack Chains
items.summary: Computer-use agents~(CUAs) have transformed large language models into persistent execution systems capable of generating, storing, and reusing artifacts like skills and memory entries. However, existing security defenses largely treat attacks as externally triggered or temporally bounded, leaving a critical gap in addressing how compromise can propagate internally through an agent's own persistent state. We reveal that malicious influence can be covertly embedded into the structural redundancies of autonomously synthesized artifacts, allowing it to survive internal state updates and bypass standard vetting mechanisms. To formalize this threat, we introduce SynChain, a self-synthesized attack paradigm utilizing persistence-aware directed supervised fine-tuning to induce agents to create poisoned yet benign-looking artifacts. To systematically evaluate this propagation, we construct CUAChain, a dataset comprising 30 benign task chains and three attack objectives. SynChain enables dormant payloads to seamlessly reactivate in future workflows as trusted context, operating entirely without new malicious exogenous inputs. Extensive experiments on OpenClaw, Codex, and Claude Code under four defense settings demonstrate that SynChain achieves high attack success and outperforms adapted baselines, proving that securing CUAs requires provenance-aware reasoning over cross-task execution trajectories.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 计算机使用代理（CUA）系统将大型语言模型（LLM）转化为可持久执行的智能体，能够生成、存储并复用技能（skills）和记忆条目（memory entries）等工件。然而，现有安全防御大多将攻击视为外部触发或时间有限的过程，未能有效应对恶意影响如何通过代理自身的持久状态进行内部传播。本文揭示了恶意影响可以被隐蔽地嵌入到自主合成工件的结构冗余之中，从而在内部状态更新时存活，并绕过常规的审查机制。为了形式化这一威胁，作者提出了 SynChain，一种自合成的攻击范式，利用持久性感知的定向监督微调（persistence-aware directed supervised fine-tuning），诱导代理创建带有恶意载荷但外表正常的工件。该攻击使得休眠的载荷能够在未来的工作流中作为可信上下文被无缝重新激活，整个过程无需任何新增的恶意外部输入。为了系统评估这种传播，作者构建了 CUAChain 数据集，包含 30 条良性任务链和三个攻击目标。在 OpenClaw、Codex 和 Claude Code 上，在四种不同防御设置下进行的广泛实验表明，SynChain 能够取得高攻击成功率，并优于调整后的基线方法。该研究证明，保护 CUA 系统需要具备来源感知的推理能力，即跨任务执行轨迹进行安全分析。本文的主要贡献包括：首次系统化揭示 CUA 内部持久化状态带来的新型攻击面，提出可复现的攻击范式与评估数据集，并在多个主流代理框架中验证了攻击的有效性，为后续安全防御研究提供了重要基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CUA 系统正快速普及，但其持久化状态引入的新攻击面尚未被充分认识。本文揭示的“内部污染”攻击可绕过传统外部输入检测，影响所有依赖技能/记忆复用的 LLM 代理，安全团队需重新审视对代理系统的信任边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有具备持久化工件（技能、记忆等）的 LLM 代理系统，如 OpenClaw、Codex、Claude Code。攻击可在无新外部输入的情况下，使代理在后续任务中反复执行被污染的指令，导致数据泄露、越权操作或长期隐蔽操控。
detection_signals_zh: 监控代理生成的技能和记忆条目的内容异常，例如隐藏指令或与任务无关的冗余逻辑
检测代理跨任务轨迹中反复出现的非预期内容重用
审计代理持久化工件在内部状态更新前后的差异变化
defense_advice_zh: 对代理的持久化工件实施来源感知的审查，记录并验证工件的生成历史
限制代理自主修改自有持久化存储的权限，增加人工审核环节
对跨任务执行轨迹进行安全监控，建立上下文完整性的校验机制
定期清理和重新验证长期保留的技能与记忆条目

items.title: IntelliAudit: Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Audit Controls
items.summary: IT audits require auditors to judge whether heterogeneous organizational evidence satisfies semantic security and compliance controls. This judgment is difficult to automate because relevant evidence is distributed across policies, records, spreadsheets, and operational artifacts, and because audit conclusions depend on evidentiary sufficiency rather than keyword matching. We present IntelliAudit, a retrieval-grounded multi-agent system for IT audit evidence evaluation. Given a control and an evidence corpus, IntelliAudit retrieves relevant artifacts, generates an evidence-grounded assessment, challenges adverse findings, adjudicates disagreements, and produces an auditor-facing recommendation with cited evidence, rationale, missing-evidence analysis, and remediation guidance. We instantiate IntelliAudit on ISO/IEC 27001 and evaluate it across multiple simulated organizations using expert auditor review and audit-readiness user feedback. The evaluation shows that IntelliAudit can support control interpretation, evidence-grounded reasoning, and audit-preparation workflows, while also revealing the importance of human oversight for calibrating sufficiency judgments and correcting overly permissive recommendations. These results suggest that retrieval-grounded multi-agent systems can assist audit evidence review, but should remain decision-support tools rather than autonomous certification systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出IntelliAudit系统，旨在解决IT审计中自动化评估证据的难题。传统审计需要审计员判断异构组织证据（如政策、记录、电子表格和操作工件）是否满足语义安全与合规控制，这种判断难以自动化，因为相关证据分散且审计结论依赖证据充分性而非关键词匹配。IntelliAudit是一个基于检索增强的多代理系统，给定一个控制项和证据语料库，它能够检索相关工件，生成基于证据的评估，挑战不利发现，裁决分歧，最终生成面向审计师的推荐意见，包含引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和补救建议。系统在ISO/IEC 27001上实例化，并在多个模拟组织中通过专家审计师审查和审计准备用户反馈进行评估。结果显示IntelliAudit能够支持控制解释、证据推理和审计准备流程，同时也揭示了人类监督对于校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松建议的重要性。作者认为，这种检索增强的多代理系统可以辅助审计证据审查，但应作为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。该研究为安全合规审计的自动化提供了新思路，强调了人机协作的必要性，适合审计自动化研究者和企业安全合规团队参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了LLM多代理在审计证据评估中的潜力与局限，提醒安全团队在引入AI审计工具时需保留人类监督，避免过度依赖自动推荐。

items.title: Telemetry and Concealment in Self-Adapting Generative AI: Logging Architecture, Adversarial Model Hiding, and the Limits of Detection
items.summary: Model risk management (MRM) guidance assumes a static model lifecycle, in which models are developed, independently validated, and implemented without further autonomous modification. Continually self-adapting generative AI systems --- models that update their own weights during production deployment --- fundamentally violate this assumption and render point-in-time validation inadequate. This paper addresses the resulting governance problem in two parts. Part I develops a rigorous telemetry architecture for such models, operating simultaneously in discrete and continuous time. We establish a Minimal Sufficient Statistic for audit purposes, construct a tamper-evident Merkle chain for discrete weight sequences, derive the appropriate continuous-time generalization via the Ito formula, and propose event-driven logging via KL divergence stopping times that is both computationally tractable and meaningful for validation. Part II asks what happens when the model provider is adversarial. A firm deploying such a model has strong incentives to conceal learning updates that would trigger mandatory validation review. We formalize this as the Model Hiding Problem and provide a systematic taxonomy of six distinct attack strategies against the Part I architecture, spanning discrete and continuous time, with a formal countermeasure for each. Together the two parts establish a dual-regime architecture in which continuous telemetry is necessary but not sufficient, narrowing---but never replacing---periodic invasive audit. The framework is model-architecture-agnostic and is designed to satisfy the three pillars of traditional MRM.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对持续自适应的生成式AI系统（即在生产部署期间自主更新自身权重的模型）对传统模型风险管理（MRM）框架的根本性挑战展开研究。传统MRM假设模型生命周期是静态的——模型经开发、独立验证、实施后不再自主修改，而持续自适应模型会违背这一假设，使基于时点（point-in-time）的验证方法失效。论文分为两部分：第一部分构建了严格的遥测（telemetry）架构，支持离散时间和连续时间两种工作模式。作者建立了审计目的的最小充分统计量（Minimal Sufficient Statistic），为离散权重序列构造了防篡改的Merkle链，利用伊藤公式（Ito formula）推导出连续时间下的推广形式，并提出基于KL散度（KL divergence）停时的事件驱动日志记录机制，该机制在计算上可行且对验证具有实际意义。第二部分探讨模型提供方为对抗性（adversarial）场景：部署此类模型的企业有强烈动机隐藏会触发强制验证审查的学习更新。作者将这一问题形式化为“模型隐藏问题”（Model Hiding Problem），并针对第一部分架构系统化地提出了六种不同的攻击策略，涵盖离散和连续时间情况，并为每种策略给出了正式的对策（countermeasure）。两部分共同建立了一个双机制（dual-regime）架构：持续遥测是必要但非充分的，它只能缩小定期侵入式审计的范围，而绝不能替代审计。该框架与具体模型架构无关，旨在满足传统MRM的三大支柱（独立性、有效性、可问责性）。本文的主要贡献包括：首次形式化定义了自适应AI治理中的遥测与对抗性隐藏问题；提供了同时覆盖离散/连续时间的系统化安全架构；给出了对抗策略的完整分类学；以及将遥测与定期审计结合的务实治理建议。适合模型风险管理从业者、AI安全工程师、监管科技（RegTech）研究员以及关注LLM生命周期治理的学者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 持续自适应AI将打破传统模型审批流程，使点状验证失效。本文为蓝队提供遥测架构与对抗隐藏攻击的分类学，帮助提前设计审计日志和反规避措施，对LLM自主更新场景下的治理具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响采用持续学习/在线更新机制的大模型部署场景，尤其是金融风控、交易策略等受监管领域；可迁移到任何需要审计自主演化模型的ML系统。
detection_signals_zh: 模型权重更新事件是否记录在防篡改Merkle链中
是否存在与KL散度停时阈值相关的异常日志缺失
连续时间更新过程中是否存在时间戳异常或日志间隙
defense_advice_zh: 部署基于Merkle链的权重审计日志，确保不可抵赖性
在模型更新触发点设置基于KL散度的停时监控，强制告警
对模型提供方实施定期侵入式审计，不以连续遥测替代
监控六种模型隐藏攻击策略对应的日志异常特征

items.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
items.summary: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks that would have failed anyway. In this paper we audit that inference. Attention based measurements are usually read from prompt dependent locations, so a wrapper changes both the content being judged and the place the signal is taken from. We therefore introduce Active Attention Probing, which supplies a fixed content independent measurement coordinate. We pair every base goal with a plain and a wrapped version and generate real completions from the target models. On Llama, wrapping raises harmful generation from 0.05 to 0.27 while harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803, so the attacks grow more dangerous while the prompts look safer to the score. Among wrapped harmful prompts the outcome AUROC is 0.220, which places the attacks that succeeded below the attacks that failed. Rare token, passive, and detector derived channels reproduce the reversal on the same matched design, and the reversal itself persists across three target models, seven attack families, and two independent judges. Distribution shift then degrades calibration and threshold transfer before it degrades ranking.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文审计了LLM内部安全分数（internal safety scores）在越狱检测中的有效性。这类分数在生成文本前对提示进行判断，通常以对有害提示和良性提示的区分能力（如AUROC）来评估，并将其视为能捕获成功攻击的证据。然而，作者指出有害意图是提示的属性，而越狱成功是目标模型、解码策略和评判器相互作用后的结果。因此，基于错误测度（有害意图而非实际攻击成功率）训练的过滤器会浪费假阳性预算在原本就会失败的攻击上。为了验证这一点，作者引入了Active Attention Probing，提供一种内容无关的固定测量坐标，避免传统注意力测量受提示包装影响的问题。他们在匹配设计中对每个基准目标构造普通和包装版本，并在多个目标模型（包括Llama）上生成真实输出。实验显示，包装使有害文本生成率从0.05上升到0.27，但有害意图AUROC从0.936下降到0.803，表明攻击变得更危险而分数却认为更安全。在包装的有害提示子集中，结果AUROC仅为0.220，意味着成功攻击的分数低于失败攻击。该反转在稀有令牌、被动和检测器派生通道上同样出现，并跨三个目标模型、七个攻击家族和两个独立评判器保持稳定。此外，分布转移会先破坏校准和阈值迁移，然后才影响排序。这项工作揭示了内部安全分数在衡量攻击结果上的根本缺陷，为越狱评估提供了新的视角和方法。适合AI安全研究人员、红队和防御者阅读，以理解现有安全分数的局限并设计更可靠的防线。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究揭示内部安全分数可能反向排序成功越狱，让看似更安全的提示实际更危险，直接影响基于此类分数的防御决策。它提醒安全团队不能盲目依赖预生成过滤，必须验证过滤器与真实攻击成功率的关联。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM安全评估体系，说明当前内部安全基准可能高估防御能力。其方法可迁移至任意基于注意力或内部表示的提示分类器，为鲁棒安全过滤器设计提供借鉴。
defense_advice_zh: 不要单独依赖内部安全分数作为越狱检测的唯一依据，应结合生成后内容审核。
在部署安全过滤时，需针对包装/改写等变体进行对抗性验证，检查AUROC与实际攻击成功率的一致性。
关注分数校准与阈值迁移，定期用真实攻击样本重新评估过滤器。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Beyond Best Response: Quantal Stackelberg Deception as Insurance Against Attacker Misspecification
items.summary: Stackelberg Security Games (SSG) assume that an attacker observes the defender's strategy and chooses the target that maximizes their expected utility perfectly. In most realistic applications this is not plausible, and in the case of cyber deception (e.g., using decoys) the purpose of the game is to induce uncertainty and mistakes. Quantal response is a common way to represent noise and mistakes in decision-making; here it replaces perfect best-response with a logit choice with rationality parameter $λ$ and results in a generalized Quantal Stackelberg Equilibrium (QSE), which recovers the classical solution exactly as $λ\rightarrow \infty$. We conduct a deeper analysis of how QSE can function as a generalized form of insurance against a variety of forms of model specification error/uncertainty; our analysis shows that QSE provides a practical way to address the important role of tie-breaking rules and model uncertainty in SSG from both a theoretical and practical perspective. We conduct an empirical evaluation in a cybersecurity case study with two networks and real vulnerabilities drawn from CVE and scored using the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS). QSE beats Stackelberg in realized defender utility spanning 144 scenarios with specification errors and 25 parameter configurations, with gains of 46\% to 175\% showing a substantial advantage in a wide variety of realistic cases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究 Stackelberg 安全博弈（SSG）中的防守策略优化问题。传统 SSG 假设攻击者能完美观察防守者策略并精确选择最大化自身期望效用的目标，但在现实场景中，尤其当防守方使用蜜罐/诱饵等网络欺骗手段时，攻击者决策往往存在噪声和认知偏差。为此，作者引入量化响应（Quantal Response）模型，用 logit 选择函数替代完美最优响应，并通过理性参数 λ 控制噪声程度，形成广义的 Quantal Stackelberg 均衡（QSE）。当 λ 趋于无穷时，QSE 退化为经典均衡。论文从理论和实践两个层面论证 QSE 可作为一种抵御模型规格错误和不确定性的'保险'，尤其解决 SSG 中的平局打破规则和模型不确定性问题。实验部分基于 CVE 真实漏洞和 CVSS 评分，构建两个网络安全网络拓扑，在 144 个规格错误场景和 25 组参数配置下对比 QSE 与经典 Stackelberg 策略。结果显示，QSE 在防守者实际效用上全面优于经典方法，提升幅度达 46% 至 175%，表明其在多种现实情形下具有显著优势。该研究适合从事博弈论安全分析、网络欺骗与防御决策研究的学者及安全架构师阅读，可为防御资源分配和诱饵部署提供更鲁棒的决策依据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现实攻击者并非完美理性，传统 SSG 最优策略易被模型误差击穿。QSE 提供鲁棒性更强的防守方案，在安全博弈和欺骗防御场景下可显著提升防御效用，是理论到实践的重要衔接。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至网络欺骗、蜜罐部署、关键基础设防资源分配等场景，帮助安全团队在不确定威胁环境下制定更稳健的策略。

items.title: China RealDID: Verifiable Credentials Anchored in Legal Identity
items.summary: Verifiable credentials (VCs) and decentralized identifiers (DIDs) enable selective disclosure but lack legal anchoring: without a trusted identity root, verifiers cannot distinguish a genuine holder from a fabricated identity. State identity systems provide biometric-grounded verification but impose three costs: verifiers must collect subjects' full personally identifiable information, infrastructure concentrates on a single API, and the state observes every transaction. We present China RealDID, a three-layer architecture -- CTID (centralized legal identity), RealDID (decentralized anchor on an open permissioned blockchain), and VCs with SD-JWT-based selective disclosure -- evaluated against five adversary classes and six security goals. The central mechanism is a content-blind government relay: the state authenticates participants and counter-signs every credential but cannot read the payload, encrypted by the issuer to the holder's public key. We describe the VC lifecycle, triple-signature chain, open template registry, and the architecture's metadata-level privacy limits, including the credential graph at the relay and presentation linkability from single-DID reuse. The design yields an asymmetric, state-bounded trust model: the state cannot impersonate or read contents; the user cannot fabricate identity or evade metadata observation. We analyze alignment with China's Personal Information Protection Law and the EU's GDPR, including the tension between immutable registries and erasure rights, and discuss generalizability through cross-border deployments with Singapore and Hong Kong.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为China RealDID的架构，旨在解决可验证凭证（VC）和去中心化标识符（DID）在法律锚定上的缺失问题。传统VC/DID支持选择性披露，但缺乏可信身份根，验证者无法确认持有者身份是否真实。国家身份系统虽能提供基于生物识别的验证，但存在三个代价：验证者需收集完整个人信息、基础设施集中于单一API、国家可观察每笔交易。为此，作者提出三层架构：CTID（中心化法律身份）、RealDID（开放许可链上的去中心化锚点）以及基于SD-JWT的VC选择性披露。核心机制是内容盲的政府中继：国家认证参与者并签署每个凭证，但无法读取由发行者加密给持有者公钥的负载。论文评估了五类对手和六个安全目标，描述了VC生命周期、三签名链、开放模板注册表，并讨论了元数据层面的隐私限制，包括中继处的凭证图和单一DID复用导致的展示链接性。该设计形成不对称、国家对界的信任模型：国家无法冒充或读取内容，用户无法伪造身份或逃避元数据观察。最后，论文分析了与中国个人信息保护法和欧盟GDPR的一致性，特别指出不可变注册表与擦除权之间的张力，并通过与新加坡和香港的跨境部署讨论普适性。本工作对于设计兼顾监管要求与用户隐私的身份基础设施具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出一种结合中心化法律身份与去中心化凭证的混合架构，其'内容盲中继'机制可能影响未来身份验证基础设施的设计。安全从业者需理解这种模式下元数据仍可被观察、凭证链路可能被追踪的隐私边界，以及法律合规与不可变数据之间的冲突，为类似系统评估提供基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 架构中的'内容盲政府中继'与三签名链设计具有可迁移性，适用于需要监管参与但需保护负载内容的场景，如数字身份、医疗健康凭证、金融KYC等。同时，其元数据级隐私限制为系统安全评估提供了参考框架。

items.title: "Operator, can you hear me?" A Faithful Line into the UNISOC Baseband
items.summary: Baseband processors are reachable over the radio at all times. Their most security-relevant logic runs deep inside protocol state machines: the control-plane handlers that gate registration, authentication, and session setup. Analyzing that logic systematically requires introspecting the firmware as it runs, which makes re-hosting the baseband necessary. Existing re-hosting work approximates the execution environment and under-approximates the SoC complexity of the baseband processor together with its surrounding components, bringing this state practically out of reach. We instead model each surrounding component, co-processors, SIM, application processor, from what a real device does, and step them in lockstep with the baseband on one shared clock. That makes faithfulness checkable at component interfaces, rather than assumed. We call this method Unislop and demonstrate it on the UNISOC UDX710, a platform in an estimated 10-15% of cellular modems and in automotive systems, not systematically analyzed before. Starting from a Quectel RM500U-CNV module, we gain code execution, defeat its firmware-integrity check, instrument the baseband, and recover its peripheral environment from the running device. The resulting re-host reaches the same control-plane states as the real device, establishes a full PDU session, and carries real IP traffic on both ingress and egress. The recovered components are shared across UNISOC's baseband lineup, so with additional reverse-engineering effort the same design extends to further targets.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对 UNISOC 基带处理器的高保真重托管（re-hosting）方法，名为 Unislop，旨在解决基带安全分析中因执行环境近似和片上系统（SoC）复杂性低估而导致的协议状态机难以系统化分析的问题。基带处理器通过无线信号始终可达，其最关键的安全逻辑位于控制面协议状态机中，涉及注册、认证和会话建立。已有重托管工作要么对执行环境做了近似，要么低估了基带处理器及其外围组件的复杂性，导致难以达到真实控制面状态。Unislop 的核心理念是从真实设备的行为出发，对每个外围组件（协处理器、SIM 卡、应用处理器）进行建模，并让它们与基带处理器在同一共享时钟上同步运行。这样，保真度可以在组件接口层面进行验证，而不是被预先假定。作者以 UNISOC UDX710 为目标平台，该平台估计占全球蜂窝调制解调器的10%-15%，并用于汽车系统，此前未被系统分析过。他们从一个 Quectel RM500U-CNV 模块出发，获取代码执行能力，绕过固件完整性校验，对基带进行插桩，并从运行中的设备恢复其外围环境。最终的重托管系统能够达到与真实设备相同的控制面状态，建立完整的 PDU 会话，并在入向和出向方向上承载真实的 IP 流量。由于恢复的组件在 UNISOC 基带系列中共享，该方法经过额外的逆向工程努力可扩展到其他目标。本文的主要贡献包括：提出高保真同步重托管方法、在真实 UNISOC 平台上验证了可行性、恢复的外围环境可复用、以及提供了一种可检查的保真度验证方式。适合基带安全研究者、移动通信协议分析人员以及从事嵌入式固件逆向工程的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 基带长期缺乏系统化分析工具，本文提供的高保真重托管方法填补了该空白，使安全研究人员能够深入分析 UNISOC 基带的控制面逻辑，发现潜在漏洞，对移动通信安全具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 UNISOC 基带系列芯片，覆盖约10-15%蜂窝调制解调器及汽车系统；该分析方法可扩展至其他基带平台，提升整个行业的安全审计能力。

items.title: Full-Key Recovery and Forgery from One MQOM v2.1 Signature
items.summary: We give a full-key-recovery attack on MQOM v2.1, a Round-3 candidate in the NIST additional-signature process, that recovers the complete signing key from one accepted signature and uses it to sign a fresh message. If $δ=\operatorname{FirstBits}_λ(x)$ is the prefix of the witness $x$, the sibling path determines a public value $A$ such that tree parity gives $s=δ\oplus A$. Substitution into the hidden-leaf commitment yields $$\mathsf{Enc}_K(δ\oplus A)=T\oplus\mathsf{LinOrtho}(δ)$$ with public values $K$ and $T$. The correction in the same signature expands a solution into a complete witness, while the public MQ relation identifies those yielding valid signing keys; serializing such a witness gives the secret key, enabling a fresh-message signature accepted by the reference verifier. We evaluate this equation over the specified AES/Rijndael circuits using retained circuit state along a Gray traversal. Complete-domain scans for Categories I and V cost $2^{142.335112}$ and $2^{271.794162}$ Boolean gates. Category-III scans cover $1/2+2^{-20}$ and $0.580004770183$ of the domain at costs of $2^{206.774558}$ and $2^{206.988685}$ gates. All four totals are below the NIST security benchmarks. Reduced-domain runs against the reference implementation recover the byte-exact witness and key in all three categories and produce a fresh-message forgery accepted by the reference verifier. Independently generated source-syntax circuits evaluate the fixed ciphers over the stated domains and translated L3 prefixes, while an exact ideal-cipher factorial-moment bound controls additional equation preimages passed to public-key validation. Every value in the equation is fixed by the accepted transcript, so salt-bound global-root expansion changes its public constants without removing the one-signature recovery channel.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对MQOM v2.1（NIST额外签名流程第3轮候选方案）提出一种全密钥恢复攻击。攻击者只需获得一个有效签名，即可恢复完整签名密钥，并据此为任意新消息生成合法签名。研究发现，通过分析签名中涉及的兄弟路径和隐藏叶承诺，可以将秘密值与公开值建立关联；同时，借助签名中的纠错信息和公开的MQ关系，能够将解扩展到完整见证，从而还原私钥。该攻击利用AES/Rijndael电路在格雷遍历中保留的电路状态进行评估。对于NIST安全级别I和V，完整域扫描的计算成本分别为2^142.335112和2^271.794162布尔门，低于相应安全基准；对于Category III的约一半域，成本也低于基准。使用参考实现进行降域运行，在所有三个类别中都恢复了逐字节的见证和密钥，并成功生成了被参考验证器接受的新消息伪造。攻击还通过独立生成的源码语法电路验证，并应用理想密码阶乘矩界控制额外方程预像。由于签名中每个值都由接受的字迹固定，盐绑定的全局根扩展无法消除这一单签名恢复通道。该研究彻底打破了MQOM v2.1的不可伪造性，对NIST后量子签名评估具有重大影响。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对于部署或评估MQOM签名方案的组织而言，该研究表明该方案在安全性上存在致命缺陷，一旦采用将导致签名密钥完全泄露。安全团队应关注NIST最终决策，避免在依赖该方案的系统上线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响采用MQOM v2.1的系统，特别是后量子过渡场景中的签名完整性；攻击成本低于NIST安全强度要求，意味着方案不再满足其宣称的安全等级。
defense_advice_zh: 建议评估现有后量子签名方案时排除MQOM v2.1，并跟踪NIST额外签名流程的后续报告。
若系统已使用该方案，应计划迁移至其他候选标准，并监控是否有异常签名行为（但攻击不需要特殊行为，难以检测）。

items.title: Sound Enforcement of Dynamic Release Information Flow Policy-Full Version
items.summary: Information flow analysis is the de facto method of assessing confidentiality and integrity issues. However, the widespread adoption of information flow analysis in real-world systems is still lacking, partly due to a fundamental gap between theory and practice: the dynamic nature of security concerns in real-world systems goes beyond the scope of existing techniques that assume a static policy (i.e., data secrecy does not change). Recognizing the fundamental gap, a substantial amount of research has studied various aspects of it (e.g., enabling declassification, endorsement, and invocation policies). A recent work takes a step further by formalizing a promising end-to-end policy called dynamic release that unifies prior formalizations by allowing information flow restrictions to downgrade and upgrade in arbitrary ways. However, how to soundly enforce the powerful dynamic release policy is still an open question. In this paper, we present the first type system that enforces dynamic release policy and formally prove its soundness. More specifically, we (1) formalize a core language that enables dynamic release policy, (2) develop a type system that checks dynamic release policy, (3) develop new proof techniques and formally prove that the type system enforces dynamic release policy, and (4) implement a prototype of the type system as an extension to the Rust language, along with case studies on conference reviewing system and Civitas.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对信息流分析（Information Flow Analysis）在真实系统中应用不足的问题展开研究。作者指出，传统信息流分析技术通常假设静态策略，即数据保密性不随时间变化，但现实系统中的安全关注点往往是动态的，例如数据需要被降级（declassification）或升级（endorsement）。尽管已有大量工作研究了动态策略的特定方面，但现有形式化体系缺乏统一性和表达能力。近期有研究提出了“动态释放”（dynamic release）策略，允许信息流约束以任意方式升级或降级，统一了之前的各种策略形式化。然而，如何可靠地（soundly）执行这种强大的动态释放策略仍然是一个开放问题。为此，本文首次提出了一个能够强制实施动态释放策略的类型系统，并正式证明了其可靠性。具体贡献包括：（1）形式化了一个支持动态释放策略的核心语言；（2）开发了一个用于检查动态释放策略的类型系统；（3）提出了新的证明技术，并正式证明了该类型系统确实强制实施了动态释放策略；（4）将该类型系统作为Rust语言的扩展实现了原型，并在会议评审系统和Civitas电子投票系统上进行了案例研究。该工作填补了动态信息流策略从理论到实践的关键空白，为构建更灵活且安全的系统提供了基础。适合对编程语言、类型系统、信息流控制以及安全策略形式化感兴趣的研究人员和高级安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了动态信息流策略无法被可靠执行的关键理论缺口，为构建适应真实业务需求（如动态授权、数据降级）的安全系统提供了首个可证明可靠的类型系统，对语言级安全机制的设计具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该类型系统可作为语言扩展（原型基于Rust）应用于需要细粒度、动态数据保护的系统，如会议评审、电子投票、权限管理及隐私保护场景；其证明技术也可推广到其他动态安全策略的形式化验证。

items.title: ANTMAN: An Efficient and Interpretable RTL-Level Run-Time Detection Framework for Stealthy Branch Predictor Attacks on BOOM
items.summary: Runtime detection of microarchitectural side channel attacks remains significantly underexplored in RISCV compared with x86 and ARM ISAs, posing a serious threat to critical applications. State-of-the-art branch predictor attacks bypass traditional data and instruction caches by directly exploiting the state of internal history tables, making them inherently stealthy. Recent research has explored offline detection of microarchitectural attacks on RISC-V; however, efficient runtime detection of microarchitectural attacks on RISC-V hardware remains significantly unaddressed. State-of-the-art hardware-based runtime detection solutions leverage hardware performance counters (HPCs) but suffer from a restricted set of counter registers and tradeoffs between detection accuracy, detection speed, and sampling granularity, making them impractical for stealthy attacks. Moreover, sampling HPCs after distinct intervals leaves intermediate relationships between different microarchitectural blocks unobserved. Additionally, proprietary x86 and ARM ISAs constrain researchers from modifying processor microarchitectural designs. To address these limitations, we propose the first secure-by-design, highly interpretable, non-intrusive, RTL-level runtime detection solution for stealthy branch predictor attacks on BOOM RISC-V, evaluated under both simplified Next-Line Predictor (NLP) and complex TAGE predictor configurations. The attack detection relies on association rules extracted offline and embedded in hardware as a non-intrusive rule monitor that enables runtime detection. The proposed approach achieves excellent detection speed, terminates execution before secret disclosure, and produces zero false positives while remaining flexible for detecting previously unseen variants within the same family of branch predictor attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对RISC-V架构上微架构侧信道攻击的运行时检测问题展开研究。与x86和ARM相比，RISC-V在此领域的研究明显不足，而关键应用面临严重威胁。现有的分支预测器攻击通过直接利用内部历史表的状态，绕过传统的数据和指令缓存，具有天然的隐蔽性。已有研究主要关注离线检测，但在RISC-V硬件上的高效运行时检测仍未解决。基于硬件性能计数器（HPC）的现有方案受限于计数器寄存器数量有限，并且需要在检测精度、速度和采样粒度之间进行权衡，难以应对隐蔽攻击；间隔采样还会遗漏不同微架构块之间的中间关系。此外，x86和ARM的专有指令集限制了对处理器微架构设计的修改。为解决这些问题，作者提出了首个安全设计（secure-by-design）、高度可解释、非侵入式的RTL级运行时检测框架ANTMAN，专门针对BOOM RISC-V处理器上的隐蔽分支预测器攻击。该框架在简化的Next-Line Predictor（NLP）和复杂的TAGE预测器配置下均进行了评估。攻击检测依赖于离线提取的关联规则，这些规则以非侵入式规则监控器的形式嵌入硬件，从而实现运行时检测。实验结果表明，该方法具备极快的检测速度，能在秘密泄露前终止执行，且零误报，同时能够灵活检测同一分支预测器攻击家族中未见过的变体。该研究填补了RISC-V微架构攻击运行时检测的空白，为构建安全的处理器设计提供了新思路。适合计算机体系结构、硬件安全和侧信道攻击检测领域的研究人员、处理器设计者以及安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RISC-V生态快速扩张，但微架构侧信道攻击的运行时防护仍属空白。该研究首次提出RTL级、非侵入式、可解释的检测方案，能零误报地拦截隐蔽分支预测器攻击，对构建安全处理器设计具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响了RISC-V处理器设计中的安全检测机制，尤其适用于BOOM等高性能乱序核；其基于关联规则的硬件监控方法可迁移到其他微架构攻击的检测场景。

items.title: DiffSafeMerge: Mitigating Backdoor Inheritance in Diffusion Model Merging
items.summary: Unconditional diffusion checkpoint merging assumes benign sources, yet a compromised public checkpoint can transfer a dormant backdoor while clean generation appears normal. Mitigation is difficult without knowing the compromised source, trigger, or target, and broad sanitization may degrade image quality. We introduce DiffSafeMerge (DSM), which uses a small unlabeled clean set and fixed, attack-agnostic stress probes to score source blocks, shrink suspicious contributions toward a trusted reference, and select attenuation under a clean denoising-loss budget. We evaluate four attacks, two datasets, and 21 target conditions. Intended merging already has zero worst-target ASR in 10 of 14 source cases; DSM preserves these outcomes and records no target match in the remaining four over three seeds, including three with baseline ASR of 48--100\%. Among methods with zero worst-target ASR on both datasets, DSM obtains the lowest case-averaged FID in the matched seed-0 comparison.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文《DiffSafeMerge: Mitigating Backdoor Inheritance in Diffusion Model Merging》针对无条件扩散模型检查点合并中的后门继承问题。当前合并方法默认假设所有源模型是可信的，但实践中，一个被恶意植入后门的公开检查点可能在被合并后，将潜伏的后门迁移到合并模型中，且日常生成结果看似正常，难以被察觉。由于攻击者通常不公开被污染源、触发器或目标类别，防御方几乎无法预知哪个模块携带恶意行为；而粗暴地对所有模块进行统一净化又容易破坏图像质量。为此，作者提出 DiffSafeMerge (DSM)。该方法只需要一个小的无标签干净数据集和一组固定且与具体攻击无关的“压力探测”（stress probes），不需要识别攻击者或触发器。其核心流程是：首先对源模型的各模块进行打分，依据其在探测下的异常表现，将可疑贡献向一个可信参考模型（如未合并的干净基座）收缩；然后在干净去噪损失预算下，自适应地选择衰减幅度，从而在净化后门的同时尽量保留正常生成能力。实验部分覆盖了四种后门攻击、两个数据集以及 21 种目标条件。结果显示，在 14 个源案例中，有 10 个案例在正常合并场景下已经实现了零最坏目标攻击成功率（ASR）；DSM 在这些案例上保持原有良好表现，并在其余 4 个案例（其基线 ASR 为 48% 到 100%）的三个随机种子中均未出现目标命中。在同时满足两个数据集上零最坏目标 ASR 的方法中，DSM 在匹配种子 0 的比较中取得了最低的案例平均 FID，表明其净化过程对图像质量影响最小。总体而言，该研究为扩散模型合并提供了一种不依赖先验攻击知识的防御思路，适合模型供应链安全研究者和 AIGC 平台安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 扩散模型开源检查点合并已成为常见工作流，但后门可在合并中悄然继承。DSM 提供无需预知攻击细节的防御方法，能显著压低目标攻击成功率且几乎不损害生成质量，对模型供应链安全具有直接借鉴价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到多模态模型融合、联邦学习模型聚合等存在多源模型集成的场景，也可用于评估任意第三方扩散检查点的潜在恶意行为。

items.title: You Are Not My Teammate: Behavioral Fingerprint-based Detection of Suspicious Account Misuse
items.summary: Online games have been continuously affected by cyber threats such as game bots and gold farming. Game bots, which are automated programs that play on behalf of human users, significantly accelerate character progression and reduce the engagement of legitimate players, potentially leading to user churn. In addition, gold farming enables the monetization of in-game currency into real-world money, resulting in unfair profits. For these reasons, prior studies have primarily focused on detecting game bots and gold farming. However, in competitive Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) games such as League of Legends, match outcomes and rankings are the primary objectives, where individual performance is more critical than in-game economic factors. Accordingly, account misuse such as account sharing and boosting has emerged as a major threat to fair competition. In this study, we propose a behavioral fingerprint-based detection method. Our approach analyzes and quantifies changes between a player's historical and recent in-game behaviors. Consequently, it enables the robust identification of suspicious account sharing and boosting, even in label-scarce environments. Experimental results show that behavioral fingerprints within the same account are distinguishable from those across different accounts, supporting rapid detection of suspicious account misuse even with limited labeled data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对在线游戏中日益严重的账户滥用问题（如账户共享和代练）提出了一种基于行为指纹的检测方法。在竞争激烈的多人在线战斗竞技场（MOBA）游戏（如英雄联盟）中，比赛结果和排名是核心目标，个人操作水平比游戏内经济因素更加重要，因此账户共享和代练行为严重破坏公平竞争，损害游戏生态。与以往主要聚焦于游戏机器人和黄金农场的研究不同，本文关注账户层面的行为异常。作者提出通过分析和量化玩家在历史记录与近期游戏行为之间的差异来构建行为指纹。具体而言，该方法利用玩家的操作模式、决策习惯等特征形成指纹，并检测同一账户内行为的变化，从而识别出可能的账户共享或代练事件。即使在标注数据有限的实际场景中，该方法也能保持鲁棒性，有效区分同一账户内的行为指纹与跨账户的行为指纹。实验结果表明，该方法能够支持对可疑账户滥用的快速检测，且仅需有限的标签数据即可获得可区分的结果。该研究为在线游戏安全提供了新的视角，并为账户滥用检测提供了可行的技术方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 账户共享和代练在竞技游戏中日益猖獗，严重破坏公平性并造成玩家流失。本文提出的行为指纹检测方法可帮助安全团队在不依赖大量标注数据的情况下，快速识别账户滥用行为，为游戏反作弊系统提供新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可推广至各类在线服务中的账号共享/欺诈检测，如金融应用、社交媒体等；也可用于识别内部威胁中的异常登录行为。

利用行为指纹建立用户画像，作为多因素认证的补充。

items.title: VUPER: Verified ASN.1 UPER Parser
items.summary: ASN.1 is a widely used interface description language, and UPER (Unaligned Packed Encoding Rules) is one of its key encoding rules, particularly popular in security-critical domains such as cellular networks and vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication. To ensure the correctness and security of this foundational infrastructure, we present VUPER, a framework for generating verified ASN.1 UPER parsers. We first formalize the notion of a bit-precise parser and identify properties that prove round-trip consistency for parsers and serializers, while accounting for ASN.1 features such as backward/forward compatibility. We then implement and verify parser and serializer combinators for ASN.1 basic types and structures, while adhering to the UPER specification. We also develop a compiler that translates ASN.1 definitions into verified parsers. Finally, we develop a dynamic testing framework using the VUPER parser as a test oracle. To empirically evaluate our approach, we test 7 open-source and 4 commercial ASN.1 parsers using 5G and V2X communication protocols. VUPER uncovers 20 types of inconsistencies in popular parsers and demonstrates stricter compliance with ASN.1 UPER standards. Additionally, we demonstrate concrete attacks by exploiting these parser vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 VUPER，一个用于生成经过验证的 ASN.1 UPER（非对齐压缩编码规则）解析器的框架。ASN.1 是一种广泛使用的接口描述语言，而 UPER 是其关键编码规则之一，在蜂窝网络、车联网（V2X）等安全关键领域应用广泛。作者首先形式化了位精确解析器的概念，并定义了验证解析器与序列化器往返一致性的属性，同时考虑 ASN.1 的向后/向前兼容性等特性。随后，他们依据 UPER 规范实现并验证了 ASN.1 基本类型和结构的解析器与序列化器组合子，并开发了一个将 ASN.1 定义转换为已验证解析器的编译器。此外，还构建了一个以 VUPER 解析器为测试基准的动态测试框架。实验评估针对 7 个开源和 4 个商业 ASN.1 解析器，使用 5G 和 V2X 通信协议进行测试。结果显示，VUPER 在流行解析器中发现了 20 类不一致性，并证明其更严格地遵循 ASN.1 UPER 标准。论文还通过利用这些解析器漏洞演示了具体攻击，但本摘要不展开攻击细节。该研究的主要贡献在于提供了一种形式化验证 ASN.1 UPER 解析器的可行方案，提高了关键基础设施中数据解析的正确性和安全性。适合编译器验证、协议安全、形式化方法领域的研究人员和工程技术人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ASN.1 UPER 解析器是 5G 和 V2X 等安全关键通信的基础组件，错误解析可能导致安全漏洞。VUPER 提供了自动化验证手段，能发现已有解析器中的不一致性，有助于提升基础设施安全性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 ASN.1 UPER 解析器的开发者和使用者，尤其是 5G、V2X 等协议栈实现。发现的问题可推动解析器修复，验证框架可迁移到其他编码规则。

items.title: SSHafe: A Real-Time SSH Brute Force Attack Detection and Novel Credential Rotation Standard
items.summary: SSH remains a critical yet heavily targeted protocol for remote system administration, with password-based authentication exposing servers to large-scale brute-force, dictionary, and credential-spray attacks. Existing rule-based defences such as Fail2Ban fail to detect slow, distributed, or threshold-aware adversaries, while conventional account-recovery mechanisms: email links, OTPs, and out-of-band verification introduce additional vulnerabilities including phishing, session hijacking, and weak authentication binding. This work presents SSHafe, a real-time SSH brute-force detection and mitigation system that combines time-series feature engineering with a lightweight LightGBM classifier to identify attack patterns directly from system authentication logs. A multi-scale sliding-window approach extracts behavioural features such as attempt rates, inter-arrival times, failure ratios, and username diversity, enabling the model to achieve a detection accuracy of 99.96% on benchmark data and strong performance on unlabeled real-world traffic. Upon detecting an attack, SSHafe automatically blocks the targeted user account and delivers an SSH banner guiding legitimate users to a novel passkey-based password-rotation workflow. The proposed novel password reset standard performs authentication and password update in a single cryptographically bound flow, eliminating the need for sessions, cookies, OTPs, or email-based verification, and mitigating phishing, session hijacking, CSRF, and replay attacks. Experiments on an Azure VM and live adversarial traffic demonstrate that SSHafe can identify and suppress brute-force activity within ten seconds, preventing account compromise even with weak credentials.

llm_summary.summary_zh: SSH（安全外壳协议）是远程系统管理的核心协议，但基于密码的认证机制使其长期面临暴力破解、字典攻击和凭证填充攻击的威胁。传统的规则型防御工具（如 Fail2Ban）在应对慢速、分布式或具备阈值规避能力的攻击者时存在明显不足；而常规的账户恢复机制（如邮件链接、OTP、带外验证）也引入了网络钓鱼、会话劫持和认证绑定薄弱等额外风险。针对上述问题，本文提出 SSHafe——一个实时 SSH 暴力破解检测与缓解系统。SSHafe 结合时间序列特征工程与轻量级 LightGBM 分类器，直接从系统认证日志中识别攻击模式。其采用多尺度滑动窗口提取行为特征，包括尝试频率、到达时间间隔、失败比例、用户名多样性等，使模型在基准数据集上达到 99.96% 的检测准确率，并在无标签的真实世界流量上表现良好。检测到攻击后，SSHafe 会自动封禁目标用户账户，并通过 SSH banner 引导合法用户进入一种基于密钥的新型密码轮换流程。该密码重置标准在一个加密绑定的流程中同时完成身份认证和密码更新，无需会话、Cookie、OTP 或邮件验证，从而缓解网络钓鱼、会话劫持、CSRF 和重放攻击。在 Azure 虚拟机上的实验及实时对抗流量测试表明，SSHafe 能在十秒内识别并抑制暴力破解活动，即使使用弱凭证也能有效防止账户失陷。本文的核心贡献在于提出了一种将机器学习检测与新型密码轮换协议相结合的实时防御体系，兼顾了检测的准确性和恢复流程的安全性。适合对 SSH 安全、异常检测、身份认证加固感兴趣的蓝队人员和安全架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SSH 是基础设施的关键入口，暴力破解长期困扰安全团队。SSHafe 将高精度实时检测与免 OTP 的密码轮换结合，为传统 Fail2Ban 的盲区提供了可行的增强思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至云服务器 SSH 防护、堡垒机日志异常检测、账户生命周期管理中的应急凭证重置场景。
detection_signals_zh: 同一源IP或用户短时间内多次认证失败，且失败比例异常升高

针对多个用户名的批量认证尝试，用户名多样性超出基线
单次会话内认证尝试频率超出阈值，或跨时间窗口的累计尝试次数异常

对检测到的攻击源 IP 或用户账户实施自动化封禁，并保证合法用户的快速恢复通道
采用绑定认证与密码更新的流程，避免依赖 OTP 或邮件链接等易受钓鱼/劫持的机制
定期评估认证日志中的慢速、分布式攻击模式，补充静态规则无法覆盖的特征

items.title: Diversity Matters: Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection for Data-Efficient Backdoor Attacks
items.summary: Backdoor attacks compromise training data so that a model retains clean accuracy but predicts an attacker-chosen target on triggered inputs. At very low poisoning rates, only a few samples convey the trigger--target association, making poison-sample selection critical. Existing methods typically rank candidates using per-sample scores, which can select redundant samples from similar semantic regions, and many require task-specific surrogate training. We propose Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection (DFCS), a training-free, trigger-agnostic method that clusters fixed pretrained features into one region per poisoning slot and selects the centroid-nearest sample from each region. A local first-order analysis relates this allocation to feature-coverage and representative-mass terms. Across BadNets and Blended attacks on CIFAR-10, Tiny-ImageNet, and Imagenette, DFCS achieves the highest mean attack success rate among seven selectors in all six dataset--attack settings, averaging $96.30\%$ and exceeding the strongest comparator in each setting by 4.60 percentage points on average while preserving clean accuracy. These results support distributional feature coverage as an effective selection principle for low-budget dirty-label backdoor attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究后门攻击中的数据选择问题。在低投毒率场景下，只有极少数带毒样本能够传达触发-目标关联，因此如何从候选集中选出最有效的毒样本成为关键挑战。现有方法通常为候选样本计算一个分数并排序，然后选取前k个，但这种方式容易在语义相似的区域选择冗余样本，且许多方法需要依赖任务特定的替代训练，通用性受限。为此，作者提出一种名为分布特征覆盖样本选择（DFCS）的方法，无需训练、且与具体触发方式无关。DFCS利用固定的预训练特征（如来自ImageNet的模型）对所有候选样本进行聚类，每个投毒槽位对应一个特征区域，并从每个区域中选择距离所在簇质心最近的样本作为该槽位的毒样本。通过局部一阶分析，作者将该分配策略与特征覆盖及代表性质量两项指标建立了理论联系。实验在CIFAR-10、Tiny-ImageNet和Imagenette三个数据集上，配合BadNets和Blended两种常见后门攻击进行验证，共六个数据集-攻击组合。结果显示，在七种样本选择器中，DFCS在全部六个设置下均取得最高平均攻击成功率，平均高达96.30%，且在每种设置下比最强对比方法平均高出4.60个百分点，同时不损害模型的干净准确率。这些结果支持了分布特征覆盖作为低预算脏标签后门攻击的有效选择原则。该研究揭示了攻击者在资源极度受限时仍能有效实施后门攻击的策略，对数据安全与模型鲁棒性研究具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了攻击者在极低投毒率下如何利用分布特征覆盖高效选择毒样本，帮助防御者理解后门攻击的底层机制，进而改进数据清洗、样本筛选和异常检测策略，对构建稳健的机器学习流水线具有警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对依赖外部数据训练的AI系统构成潜在威胁，尤其在数据审核成本高的场景下，低投毒率攻击的隐蔽性增强。

items.title: Context Is Not Authority: Structured Runtime Governance for Financial Market Agents
items.summary: Financial agents can turn correct context into an unauthorized effect: a customer-facing commitment, trade, or deployed policy. We present SAGE-Fin, a finance-specific authority-handoff contract that makes the proposed effect, not merely its text, the object of runtime control. SAGE-Fin compiles proposals into typed, adapter-bound candidates; records missing or stale institutional obligations as coverage debt; contracts authority under current market, account, policy, and dialogue state; and requires an exact-artifact receipt whose nominal type matches the consuming response, execution, or policy adapter. Evidence and workflow progress cannot substitute for effect authority, and prior authorization is rechecked after state changes. Across an authored 616-case catalog, five deterministic specifications yield 3,080 outputs; a label-isolated harness obtains 616/616 binary reference-prototype parity, including 3/3 named response-gate fixtures, while 22 tests cover selected paths. These results establish executable conformance, not independent safety accuracy. Separately, SAGE-Fin's response gate processed real customer-facing production requests at a confidential digital-asset platform. An operational team independent of the implementation team reached a strongly positive post-deployment conclusion on practical usefulness and workflow fit, and end-user feedback was also strongly positive. Disclosure permits only the review's independence, stakeholder classes, assessed dimensions, and directional conclusion, so this is qualitative field corroboration rather than an aggregate effect estimate. Three distinct de-identified predecessor failures, with independently confirmed 0/3 interception, ground repeated-emission drift, stale account evidence, and missing escalation state without estimating prevalence or treatment effect.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 金融领域的 AI 智能体（agent）可能将正确的上下文转化为未经授权的实际效果，例如代表客户做出承诺、执行交易或部署策略。这种风险源于对生成的文本进行控制，而缺少对‘效果’本身的运行时治理。针对这一问题，本文提出 SAGE-Fin，一个面向金融市场的结构化运行时治理框架。其核心是一个财务专用的授权交接契约（authority-handoff contract），将控制对象从文本内容转变为提议执行的效果。SAGE-Fin 将智能体的提议编译为带类型的、与适配器绑定的候选动作；把缺失或过时的机构义务记录为覆盖债（coverage debt）；并结合当前市场状态、账户状态、策略状态与对话状态动态授予权限；同时要求返回一个精确的工件收据（artifact receipt），其名义类型必须与消费该效果的响应、执行或策略适配器匹配。证据与工作流进展不能替代效果授权，且任何状态变化都会触发对先前授权的重新检查。实验方面，作者构建了 616 个案例的目录，通过五个确定性规范生成 3080 个输出；使用标签隔离的测试框架获得 616/616 的二进制参考原型一致性，包括 3/3 的命名响应门夹具，并有 22 个测试覆盖选定的路径。需要强调的是，该结果证实的是可执行的一致性，而非独立的安全准确率。此外，SAGE-Fin 的响应门被部署在一个保密数字资产平台的真实生产请求上，由独立于实现团队的运营团队进行了评估，得到强烈正面的实用性判断，最终用户反馈也积极。但受披露限制，该部署仅能作为定性现场佐证，不能作为总体效果估计。研究还分析了三个去标识化的前序失败案例，独立确认 0/3 的拦截率，分别对应重复生成漂移、过时账户证据和缺失升级状态，但未估计流行率或处理效应。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对 LLM 智能体在金融场景中可能绕过文本级控制、造成未授权交易或承诺的风险，SAGE-Fin 提出以‘效果’为对象的运行时授权与审计机制，为构建可治理的 AI 代理系统提供了新范式，适合安全架构师评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方法可迁移到金融交易、客户服务、策略执行等高风险场景，也可为其他领域的智能体运行时安全提供参考。

items.title: Mind the Hook: Source-Level Auditing of Privacy Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: Black-box privacy scores for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are difficult to interpret unless the audited defense's active pipeline hook is known. We propose an active-path audit: inventory source-level hooks over retrieval, retrieved content, and generation; map each metric to the leakage channel it observes; and validate generated-text effects with exact-match canaries. In our benchmark reimplementations, the DP-style defenses modify retrieval scores only: their generation hooks are TODO-flagged stubs that return responses unchanged. This active path explains why they affect membership-inference behavior but track No-Defense on generated-text named-entity leakage, measured by NEL_strict. By contrast, the end-to-end LPRAG path is canary-validated on the email channel, recovering 53/150 canaries under No-Defense and 0/150 under LPRAG. These findings concern our reimplementations on our stack, not released defenses or defense families; the contribution is a methodology and case study, not a universal ranking

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的隐私防御机制提出了一种源级审计方法。现有黑盒隐私评分难以解释，除非知道被审计防御在活跃管线中的具体挂钩（hook）位置。作者提出“活跃路径审计”（active-path audit），包括三个步骤：盘点检索、检索内容和生成阶段中的源级挂钩；将每个隐私指标映射到其观测的泄漏通道；使用精确匹配的“金丝雀”（canary）数据验证生成文本的效果。在作者构建的基准重实现中，DP风格的防御仅修改了检索阶段的分数，其生成阶段的挂钩是带有待办标记的桩模块，返回的响应未做任何修改。这一活跃路径解释了为什么这些防御会影响成员推断行为，但在生成文本的命名实体泄漏（以NEL_strict衡量）上却与无防御表现一致。相比之下，端到端的LPRAG路径在电子邮件通道上通过了金丝雀验证：在无防御下恢复53/150个金丝雀，而在LPRAG下恢复0/150。作者强调，这些发现仅针对其自建栈上的重实现，不适用于官方发布的防御或防御家族；本文的贡献是提出一种方法学和案例研究，而非通用排名。适合关注RAG隐私保护、模型审计和LLM安全的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为RAG隐私防御提供了可操作的审计方法论，帮助蓝队理解防御的真实生效位置，避免被黑盒分数误导。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何基于管线的LLM系统审计场景，用于验证隐私保护组件是否真正覆盖生成阶段。

items.title: From Noise to Meaning: Meaningful Secret Sharing with Tamper Detection for Facial Recognition
items.summary: Popularity of AI-based face recognition system directly demands protection of sensitive biometric data used for training. Visual secret sharing is an interesting idea, as it splits facial images into secret shares that look random and spread across many institutions. However, these shares look like noise and can easily spark suspicion and recognized as encrypted content. This makes them open to targeted collection and harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. Additionally, visual secret sharing does not detect tampering, allowing attackers to modify shares and threaten the integrity of reconstruction. In this paper, we introduce a new method that turns distracting noise-like secret shares into visually appealing cover images with additional cryptographic tamper detection. The proposed technique works with visual secret sharing and introduces cover images to embed the shares using adaptive least significant bit steganography. Here, cover images with perceptual transparency are used to store secret shares while guaranteeing complete privacy. A two layer authentication using strong digital watermarking and cryptographic hashing is used to protect the integrity of shares. The proposed technique shows high resilience in stopping bit-flipping, cropping, and substitution attacks. Extensive experiments on multiple public face datasets show that the technique shows better FR accuracy, while eliminating share conspicuousness and guaranteeing integrity. The proposed framework sets a new standard for protecting facial data in such a way that privacy, security, and integrity are protected.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着基于AI的人脸识别系统广泛应用，用于训练的生物特征数据保护变得至关重要。视觉秘密共享（Visual Secret Sharing）将人脸图像拆分成看似随机噪声的份额，并可分散存储于多个机构，但这类份额作为噪声容易引起怀疑，被视为加密内容，从而可能遭受针对性收集及“先收集后解密”（harvest-now-decrypt-later）攻击。此外，传统视觉秘密共享无法检测篡改，攻击者可修改份额以破坏重构图像的完整性。针对上述问题，本文提出了一种新方法：通过自适应最低有效位（Adaptive LSB）隐写术，将原本类似噪声的密钥份额嵌入到具有视觉吸引力的封面图像中，在保证感知透明的同时完全隐藏秘密。该方法同时引入强数字水印和密码学哈希构成两层认证机制，以保护份额的完整性。实验表明，所提技术在多个公共人脸数据集上不仅对人脸识别（FR）准确率有所提升，而且彻底消除了份额的显眼性，并能够有效抵抗位翻转（bit-flipping）、裁剪（cropping）和替换（substitution）攻击。该框架将隐私性、安全性和完整性相结合，为面部数据的保护设立了新的标准，尤其适合需要跨机构安全协作的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法将秘密分享的噪声份额伪装为自然图像，显著降低被识别和定向收集的风险，同时增加完整性校验能力，帮助蓝队在不暴露原始敏感数据的前提下进行分布式的安全存储与协作，值得安全从业者关注其应用和潜在扩展。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于任何需要跨机构共享敏感生物特征、医疗记录等数据的场景，提升隐蔽性和防篡改性；也可为联邦学习中的隐私保护提供参考。
detection_signals_zh: 对封面图像进行隐写分析以发现隐藏数据
校验数字水印或哈希以检测份额篡改
defense_advice_zh: 在敏感数据分发时采用带完整性校验的隐写秘密分享
部署水印/哈希双重验证机制防止份额被篡改

items.title: Treating Statewide CORS Networks as Spatially Distributed Sensors for GNSS Integrity Monitoring under Unintentional and Deliberate Threats
items.summary: State departments of transportation (DOTs) in the United States increasingly rely on statewide continuously operating reference station (CORS) networks to support high-precision Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning and timing for intelligent transportation systems. These networks also provide continuous observations that can support regional GNSS integrity monitoring. This study develops and demonstrates a framework that treats a statewide CORS network as a spatially distributed sensor system for identifying unintentional (environmental) and intentional (cyber) interference when GNSS measurements deviate from expected spatial patterns. We develop a graph-based Network Consistency Framework (NCF) that evaluates each station against its spatial neighborhood using four metrics: neighborhood residual, spatial gradient, residual, and graph smoothness. These metrics are combined into a Network Consistency Index (NCI). The framework is demonstrated using two consecutive days of four-constellation observations from 50 stations in the Alabama DOT-maintained CORS network, using changes in vertical total electron content (ΔVTEC) and the Rate of TEC Index (ROTI) as spatially coherent observables. The framework quantified network-wide spatial consistency and identified localized anomalies. Detected anomalies indicate stations whose observations deviated from the surrounding regional network, signaling potential integrity issues. Determining whether anomalies result from receiver faults, localized interference, spoofing, or other causes requires further investigation. This study introduces statewide CORS networks as regional GNSS integrity observatories and presents the NCF and NCI for graph-based spatial integrity monitoring. Transportation agencies can implement the framework using existing CORS observations to monitor network integrity and identify localized anomalies.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对美国各州交通部门（DOT）越来越依赖全州连续运行参考站（CORS）网络来支持智能交通系统所需的高精度GNSS定位与授时这一背景，提出利用该网络作为空间分布式传感器，以识别无意（环境）和故意（网络）干扰。由于GNSS测量在受到干扰时会偏离预期空间模式，作者设计了一个基于图的网络一致性框架（NCF），对每个站点与其空间邻域进行比较，采用邻域残差、空间梯度、残差和图平滑度四个度量，并结合为网络一致性指数（NCI）。该框架使用阿拉巴马州DOT维护的50个CORS站点、连续两天的四星座观测数据进行演示，以垂直总电子含量变化（ΔVTEC）和TEC变化率指数（ROTI）作为空间相干可观测值。实验表明，框架能够量化全网空间一致性并识别出局部异常站点，这些站点的观测值偏离了周边区域网络，提示潜在完整性问题。但异常的具体原因（接收机故障、局部干扰、欺骗等）需要进一步调查。本研究的主要贡献是将全州CORS网络引入作为区域GNSS完整性观测平台，并提出了NCF和NCI用于基于图的空间完整性监测。交通机构可直接利用现有CORS观测实施该框架，以增强对网络完整性的持续监测和局部异常发现。该工作为GNSS完好性监测提供了新的思路，尤其适用于关键基础设施中的位置服务保障。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GNSS欺骗和干扰是日益严峻的网络物理威胁。该研究利用现有交通CORS网络实现对局部干扰的自动检测，为关键基础设施的GNSS完整性监测提供了低成本、可部署的技术路径，值得安全从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面：适用于所有依赖CORS网络的高精度定位服务，可扩展至其他空间分布的传感器网络异常检测；对智能交通、电力授时等关键基础设施有借鉴意义。

items.title: HaloMark: A Spectral Threshold for Embedding-Vector Watermarking under C2PA
items.summary: Foundation-model embeddings are now a primary data asset, but the content-provenance machinery built for images and audio does not transfer to them. C2PA binds to an asset with a stable bit-level or perceptual identity; embeddings have neither, since quantisation, projection, fine-tuning, and windowed averaging reshape them in normal use and break any fixed hash. We present HaloMark, a watermark for embedding vectors cryptographically bound to a C2PA manifest. It composes four standard primitives -- a block-diagonal orthogonal rotation, public whitening, an input-dependent LSH commitment, and a per-vector nonce -- around one protocol change: the producer signs the LSH commitment c into the C2PA sidecar, and the verifier reads c from the manifest instead of recomputing it. Recomputing is fragile under whitening, which flips the commitment bucket on 62% of inputs at cos = 0.96; reading the signed c reduces the verifier's score to T = T_null + beta(A)*epsilon, so security turns on a single scalar beta, which we bound rigorously for linear and non-adaptive attackers and characterise empirically for the adaptive case. We evaluate against an adversary holding polynomially many clean/watermarked pairs under one key with full sidecar visibility, across eight baselines and ten adaptive attackers including denoising-autoencoder removal. The eleven encoders separate at an empirical threshold eff_rank(Sigma)/d ~= 0.19: above it, detection AUROC stays at 0.98 or higher across every in-budget attack on the three encoders we sweep in full, and at 0.965 or higher under single-seed DAE removal on the rest; below it every variant we tested fails. Why the threshold is dimension-uniform is left open. Deployed as a Qdrant admission filter, the verifier runs at 284 us and 24 bytes of sidecar per vector, validated end-to-end against three C2PA reference-SDK bindings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: HaloMark 提出了一种面向基础模型 embedding 向量的水印方案，并使其与 C2PA 内容溯源标准绑定。由于 embedding 在量化、投影、微调和窗口平均等常规操作下会改变数值，无法像图像或音频那样使用稳定的位级或感知哈希进行绑定，因此现有 C2PA 机制无法直接迁移。HaloMark 的核心思路是将四个标准原语组合：块对角正交旋转、公开白化、输入相关的 LSH 承诺和每向量随机数，并引入一个关键协议变化：生产者将 LSH 承诺 c 签名进 C2PA 侧车（sidecar），验证者直接从清单中读取 c 而不是重新计算。重新计算在白化后非常脆弱，在 cos=0.96 时会导致 62% 的输入翻转承诺桶；而读取已签名的 c 可将验证得分简化为 T = T_null + beta(A)*epsilon，安全强度归结为单个标量 beta。作者对线性和非自适应攻击者给出了严格的 beta 上界，并自适应场景进行了实证刻画。评估中考虑了拥有单密钥下多项式级别干净/水印配对、可完全查看侧车的攻击者，覆盖八个基线和十个自适应攻击者，包括去噪自编码器移除攻击。实验发现 11 个编码器在经验阈值 eff_rank(Sigma)/d ≈ 0.19 处出现分界：高于该阈值时，在三个完整扫描的编码器上所有预算内攻击的检测 AUROC 不低于 0.98，其余编码器上单种子 DAE 移除攻击下 AUROC 不低于 0.965；低于该阈值时所有测试变体均失败。该阈值的维度均匀性原因仍属开放问题。在 Qdrant 准入过滤器部署中，验证器运行时间为 284 微秒，每个向量仅需 24 字节侧车数据，并已针对三个 C2PA 参考 SDK 绑定完成端到端验证。该研究适合关注 AI 数据资产溯源、模型水印、内容真实性校验的研究人员与蓝队工程师阅读，为 embedding 资产保护提供了一种可落地的密码学与机器学习交叉方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: embedding 已成为核心数据资产，但现有溯源机制无法适用。HaloMark 首次将 C2PA 绑定到向量级水印，为 AI 资产溯源和篡改检测提供了可量化安全边界的基准方案，对依赖 embedding 的检索增强生成、向量数据库场景有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 AI 数据资产溯源、向量数据库准入控制、模型泄露追踪、RAG 系统内容验证等场景；验证器开销低（284us/向量，24B 侧边信息），便于集成到现有 MLOps 管道。

items.title: Whose Refusal Is It? The Unmeasured Contribution of Black-Box Multimodal Guardrails
items.summary: A black-box guardrail is evaluated as though the safety number it earns were its own. It is not. A defended pipeline holds two components that can refuse (the guardrail, and the target model out of its own alignment), and every reported metric is a sum over both. We show that the guardrail's actual share of the safety credited to it runs from none of it to essentially all of it, decided by two variables no evaluation records: which channel carries the payload, and what text the harness places in the defense's internal read. The split is recoverable at no extra cost, because a guard block replaces the model's response and the two counts are therefore disjoint. On a text guard across two open-weight targets: with the payload rendered as pixels the guard blocks nothing and the model produces every refusal the system makes; reading the encoded prompt the attacker actually sent, the guard produces a minority of the refusals attributed to it; reading the unencoded request behind the attack, it blocks almost everything and the model falls silent. The blindness is not inaccuracy: the same guards block no benign image inputs either, so their image-channel decision is a constant. Granting the unencoded request inflates measured benefit substantially for a guard gate, less for a caption-mediated re-check, and not at all for a majority-vote smoother; the ordering reproduces in an independent replicate. Isolating the grant within one defense shows it does not improve detection: the harm-verdict stage contributes nothing, while the stage that regenerates the answer carries the effect. Nor is the inflated setting careless; the reference implementation builds every stage from a single prompt field that cannot distinguish what the attacker sent from what the benchmark records, so faithful porting supplies it silently. Previously published figures of our own are among those revised.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对黑盒多模态护栏（guardrail）在安全评估中的指标归属偏差问题展开研究。通常，一个包含护栏的防御流水线会被整体评估，其报告的安全分数被默认视为护栏自身的贡献，但由于被保护的目标模型本身也具备对齐能力，实际拒绝可能来自两者之和。作者通过受控实验证明，护栏被归功的拒绝量可以介于零到全部之间，而决定因素恰恰是评估记录中未记录的两个变量：载荷的传输通道（文本还是像素）以及测试框架在护栏内部读取的文本内容。由于拒绝响应与护栏拦截在计数上互斥，研究者可以无额外成本地拆分两类拒绝来源。实验使用文本护栏和两个开源权重目标模型进行验证：当载荷以像素形式呈现时，护栏完全不拦截，全部拒绝都来自目标模型；当护栏读取到攻击者实际发送的编码提示时，只有少数拒绝可归因于护栏；当读取到攻击背后的未编码原始请求时，护栏拦截了几乎全部攻击，模型自身则几乎没有拒绝。这种失效并非检测不准确，而是图像通道的决策近乎常值。此外，论文测试了三种护栏集成方式（门控、字幕中介复检、多数投票平滑）在将未编码请求作为护栏输入时，其测量收益的提升程度各不相同：门控提升最大，复检次之，多数投票无提升，且结果在独立复制实验中重现。进一步在单一护栏内部隔离该输入设定后，发现它并不改善真正的检测能力：危害判定阶段无贡献，而重新生成答案的阶段承担了全部效果。作者还指出，该设定并非粗心所致，参考实现的所有阶段共用一个提示字段，无法区分攻击者原始载荷与基准记录内容，因此忠实移植会静默引入该偏差。论文最后修订了此前公开的若干实验结果。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全评估中护栏的真实贡献常被系统性高估，该研究揭示了评估方法中的隐性配置如何扭曲安全指标，对依赖黑盒护栏告警的蓝队有直接警示意义，提醒其关注护栏与模型自身拒绝的边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响多模态安全护栏的评估流程、开源基准测试设计，以及部署LLM防护流水线的组织对安全有效性的判断。

items.title: Robust Reputation-Driven Crowdsourced Federated Learning
items.summary: Crowdsourced Federated Learning (CrowdFL) extends traditional federated learning by enabling open and heterogeneous participation through a crowdsourcing paradigm. In this setting, reputation-driven incentive mechanisms are commonly employed to guide worker selection and enhance trustworthiness. While such approaches improve participant reliability, existing frameworks largely overlook the quantification of their robustness against stealthy adversaries, particularly those capable of evading standard detection mechanisms. To fill this gap, this paper proposes R2CFL, a robust reputation-driven CrowdFL framework. R2CFL introduces a robust reputation model coupled with a nearest neighbor mixing (R2-NNM) defense mechanism that links reputation evolution with the filtering of updates during aggregation. The proposed mechanism prevents stealthy attackers from gradually accumulating trust and influencing future tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that R2-NNM matches or surpasses state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust and backdoor defense mechanisms against adaptive attackers. Furthermore, when integrated with existing detect-and-filter defenses, the proposed reputation model faithfully captures the statistical robustness of the underlying defense by producing reputation scores that closely reflect its true positive and false positive characteristics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对众包联邦学习（Crowdsourced Federated Learning, CrowdFL）中的鲁棒性问题展开研究。CrowdFL 通过众包范式允许开放和异构的参与者加入联邦学习，但这也引入了恶意或不可靠的参与者。现有工作通常使用基于声誉的激励机制来选择工人并提升可信度，但大多未系统评估该机制在对抗隐蔽攻击者（特别是能够规避标准检测的对手）时的鲁棒性。为填补这一空白，作者提出 R2CFL 框架，其核心是一个鲁棒声誉模型（R2）与最近邻混合防御机制（R2-NNM）。该机制将声誉动态与聚合时的更新过滤相结合，防止隐蔽攻击者逐步累积信任并影响后续任务。实验表明，R2-NNM 在抵御自适应攻击者方面，能达到或超过现有最先进的拜占庭鲁棒与后门防御方法。此外，当与已有的检测-过滤防御集成时，所提声誉模型能够忠实反映底层防御的统计鲁棒性，其产生的声誉分数与防御的真实阳性率和假阳性率高度一致。该工作的主要贡献包括：首次系统性地将声誉机制与最近邻混合防御结合以应对渐进式信任攻击；提出一种可解释且可迁移的声誉度量方法；通过实验验证了该框架在多种攻击场景下的有效性。适合关注联邦学习安全、鲁棒聚合机制设计以及声誉系统可靠性的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 联邦学习中的隐蔽攻击者可通过逐步累积信任绕过基于声誉的防御，R2CFL 提供了一种将声誉演化与更新过滤深度融合的防御思路，对设计更鲁棒的众包学习系统具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何采用声誉机制的协作式机器学习平台，特别是开放参与场景下的数据聚合与节点筛选。

items.title: Algebraic Attack on Convolutional Neural Networks with Max Pooling
items.summary: Recovering the weights and biases of deep neural networks (DNNs) via black-box input-output queries, known as parameter extraction attacks, has been extensively studied for ReLU-based fully connected neural networks (FCNNs), but remains unexplored for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with the max pooling function, a core architecture for computer vision and multimedia processing. The key challenge lies in the CNN max pooling layer, which introduces an additional non-linearity and hides ReLU critical points, rendering existing FCNN extraction methods inapplicable. To address this gap, we propose the first cryptanalytic extraction attack tailored for CNNs with the max pooling function. First, we establish an algebraic representation of CNNs, formally proving that CNNs are piecewise linear functions enabling the extension of linearity-based extraction principles. We then identify two novel types of critical points in CNNs: ReLU-Pooling Critical Points (RPCPs) and Pooling Switching Points (PSPs). We design complementary extraction techniques: a pattern matching method for RPCPs to recover partial signatures and signs, and an internal differential extraction attack for PSPs, inspired by cryptographic internal differential analysis, to recover high-accuracy signatures. Given that PSPs are far more abundant than RPCPs and yield a highly efficient extraction method, and that RPCPs are indispensable for bias recovery, we integrate both methods: the PSP method enables efficient signature extraction, while a single RPCP recovers the sign and bias. We evaluate our attack on multiple CNN architectures, including modern adaptations of LeNet-5, trained on random data, MNIST, and CIFAR-10. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves high extraction accuracy with polynomial query complexity and runtime, even for deep CNN layers. This work fills a research gap in CNN security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次提出针对带最大池化（Max Pooling）的卷积神经网络（CNN）的参数提取攻击，填补了该领域的研究空白。此前，基于黑盒输入输出查询的DNN参数提取攻击主要针对ReLU全连接网络（FCNN），而CNN因最大池化层引入额外非线性和对ReLU临界点的隐藏，导致现有方法失效。作者首先建立了CNN的代数表示，形式化证明CNN是分段线性函数，从而可将线性提取原理扩展至CNN。随后识别出两类新型临界点：ReLU-池化临界点（RPCP）和池化切换点（PSP），并设计了互补的提取技术：针对RPCP的图案匹配方法用于恢复部分签名和符号，以及受密码学内部差分分析启发的针对PSP的内部差分提取攻击，用于恢复高精度签名。由于PSP数量远多于RPCP且提取效率极高，而RPCP对偏置恢复不可或缺，研究者将两种方法集成：PSP方法实现高效签名提取，单个RPCP即可恢复符号和偏置。实验在多种CNN架构上进行，包括LeNet-5的现代变体，在随机数据、MNIST和CIFAR-10上训练。结果表明，该方法在多项式查询复杂度和运行时间内实现高提取精度，甚至适用于深层CNN。该工作填补了CNN安全研究空白，揭示了卷积架构在模型窃取攻击下的脆弱性。适合AI安全研究者、模型知识产权保护工程师以及关注深度学习模型机密性的安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次证明带最大池化的CNN可被代数提取攻击破解，揭示主流视觉模型的结构性弱点，对模型知识产权保护与AI安全审计有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用CNN的计算机视觉服务、边缘端模型部署场景，可迁移至其他分段线性网络（如ResNet、部分Transformer）的参数泄露评估。

items.title: Velosiraptor: Code Synthesis for Memory Translation
items.summary: Security is among the top concerns of operating system (OS) developers. A secure runtime environment relies on the OS to correctly configure the memory hardware on which it runs. This is mission-critical as it provides essential security-relevant features and abstractions that ensure the integrity and isolation of untrusted applications running alongside each other. Configuring a platform's memory hardware is not a one-off effort as designers constantly develop new mechanisms for translation and protection with different features and means of configuration. Adapting the OS code to the new hardware is not only a manual, repetitive and time consuming task, it may also introduce subtle, but security critical bugs that break security and isolation guarantees. We present Velosiraptor, a system that automatically generates correct, low-level OS code that programs the memory hardware of a machine. Velosiraptor leverages software synthesis techniques and exploits the domain specificity of the problem to make the synthesis process efficient. With Velosiraptor, developers write only a high-level description of the memory hardware's mapping behavior and OS environment. The Velosiraptor toolchain transforms this specification into a verified implementation that can be linked directly with the rest of the operating system. Incorporating the OS environment into this process allows porting an OS to new hardware platforms without worrying about writing code to configure the memory hardware. We can also use the same specification to generate hardware components. This enables research in new translation mechanisms, freeing up OS developers from manually writing OS code.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 Velosiraptor，一个通过软件综合自动生成低层操作系统（OS）代码的系统，用于编程机器的内存硬件。研究背景在于：操作系统开发者需要正确配置内存硬件以确保安全运行时环境，包括不可信应用间的隔离和完整性保护。然而，随着架构师不断设计新的地址翻译和保护机制，适配OS代码到新硬件成为一项手动、重复且易出错的任务，可能引入细微但严重的安全漏洞。Velosiraptor 的核心方法是利用软件综合技术，结合领域特定性使综合过程高效。开发者只需编写内存硬件的映射行为和OS环境的高级描述，工具链将该规范转换为经过验证的实现，可直接与OS其余部分链接。通过将OS环境纳入综合过程，可将OS移植到新硬件平台而无需手动编写内存硬件配置代码。此外，同一规范还可用于生成硬件组件，支持对新型翻译机制的研究，解放OS开发者。该论文的主要贡献包括：提出了一个自动生成正确、低层OS内存配置代码的框架，证明了软件综合在此场景的可行性，并展示了从规范生成软硬件的能力。适合操作系统开发者、安全工程师以及研究体系结构和OS交叉领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究有望消除OS适配新内存硬件时的手动编码错误，这些错误常导致安全隔离被破坏；自动综合验证代码能显著提升系统安全基线的可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响操作系统移植效率和安全性，可迁移到设备驱动生成、内存管理单元配置等场景，也可能促进硬件-软件协同设计。

items.title: Guixu: Valuation-Driven Data Discovery for Autonomous AI Agents with On-Chain Attestation
items.summary: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on external data to complete downstream tasks such as model training and decision support. However, existing data discovery systems remain largely retrieval-oriented: they surface candidate datasets from heterogeneous sources, but provide limited support for estimating task-specific utility, selecting cost-effective datasets under budget constraints, or incorporating trustworthy feedback from prior usage. This paper presents Guixu, a valuation-driven data discovery system for autonomous agents. Guixu employs a three-phase valuation pipeline with proxy-label propagation and multi-round knapsack optimization for task-aware data valuation. Guixu integrates agentic payment protocol to enable budget-constrained data procurement workflows. Guixu leverages on-chain data market and attestation signals for verifiable data discovery. Our demonstration highlights how Guixu enables an agent to move beyond keyword-based dataset retrieval toward task- and budget-aware, trustworthy data discovery and procurement. Attendees can interactively explore the full workflow, from NL task specification and multi-source search to data valuation and verifiable transaction feedback.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 自主AI代理在完成模型训练和决策支持等下游任务时，越来越依赖外部数据。然而，现有数据发现系统主要面向检索：从异构来源返回候选数据集，但缺乏对任务特定效用的估算、在预算约束下的成本效益选择，以及来自先前使用的可信反馈的整合能力。为此，本文提出Guixu——一个面向自主代理的估值驱动数据发现系统。Guixu采用三阶段估值流水线，利用代理标签传播和多轮背包优化，实现任务感知的数据估值；同时集成代理支付协议，支持预算受限的数据采购工作流；并利用链上数据市场和证明信号，实现可验证的数据发现。该系统使代理能够超越基于关键词的数据集检索，转向任务感知、预算感知、可信的数据发现与采购。演示环境允许交互式探索完整工作流，包括自然语言任务规范、多源搜索、数据估值和可验证交易反馈。该研究为构建可信数据供应链与自主代理决策提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 从蓝队视角，自主代理的数据获取可能引发数据完整性、供应链信任与合规风险。Guixu将链上证明与数据估值引入数据发现流程，有助于审计代理决策依赖的数据来源与采购行为，对AI代理安全监控和治理具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可影响依赖外部数据源的AI代理系统、数据市场、数据资产管理与审计场景。
defense_advice_zh: 对代理的数据源启用来源验证，确保审计轨迹完整。
监控代理数据采购中的预算使用与异常交易模式。
结合链上证明信号对数据市场交互进行合规校验。

items.title: Private Anytime Selective-Risk Certification for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Guarantees and Empirical Limits
items.summary: Selective-risk certificates promise that accepted outputs meet a declared error target. We develop Fed-SRC, a score-agnostic certificate for federated, differentially private, adaptively monitored retrieval-augmented generation. Clients release only Gaussian-perturbed score and loss histograms. Record-indexed and noise-variance-indexed martingales jointly bound target-risk contrast and accepted mass over all registered thresholds and rounds, permitting predictable recruitment, dropout, threshold selection, and optional stopping. A range-one total-variation term transfers the calibration mixture to a declared deployment mixture. The contribution is this private, federated, anytime combination, rather than the contrast statistic or acceptance floor individually. Empirically, no simultaneous-bound violation occurs in any evaluated cell, privacy level, or policy. Operational power depends on the score and population: the primary target r*=0.10 never certifies, and on RAGTruth the secondary target r*=0.20 never certifies either, whereas on HaluEval question answering it certifies in all 200 non-private trials, with held-out risk below the target. Naively privatized non-private certificates violate their bounds in 146 to 198 of 200 trials. As an exploratory comparison, we also evaluate a private betting-capital heuristic for which we do not establish e-process validity. This heuristic stops certifying at epsilon <= 4, where Fed-SRC still certifies. Certification nevertheless consumes roughly 30 times more stream events than unique calibration items.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 Fed-SRC，一种用于联邦、差分隐私、自适应监控的检索增强生成（RAG）的选择性风险认证框架。选择性风险认证的目标是保证被接受的模型输出满足预设的错误率目标。Fed-SRC 的核心创新在于提供了一种与具体评分函数无关（score-agnostic）的认证方法，能够在联邦学习环境中，在客户端仅上传经过高斯扰动扰动的评分与损失直方图的前提下，对模型输出的质量提供统计保证。该方法利用记录索引和噪声方差索引的两类鞅过程，在全部注册阈值和轮次上联合约束目标风险对比量与接受样本质量，从而支持可预测的客户端招募、退出、阈值选择以及可选停止。此外，通过一个取值在 [0,1] 范围的全变差项，Fed-SRC 能够将校准混合分布上的保证迁移到声明的部署混合分布上。论文的核心贡献并非单一的风险对比统计量或接受阈值下限，而是这种将隐私保护、联邦学习和任意时间（anytime）保证结合起来的整体框架。实验结果表明，在所有评估的单元、隐私水平和策略下，都没有出现同步边界违反。实际操作能力依赖于评分函数和数据集：对于主要目标 r*=0.10，Fed-SRC 在所有设置下均未能给出认证；在 RAGTruth 数据集上，二级目标 r*=0.20 也从未通过认证；但在 HaluEval 问答数据集上，该目标在所有 200 次非私有试验中均成功认证，且保留风险低于目标。相比之下，简单将非私有证书进行私有化处理会导致在 200 次试验中有 146 至 198 次违反边界。论文还探索性比较了一种私有投注资本启发式方法，但未为其建立 e-process 有效性；该方法在 epsilon<=4 时停止认证，而 Fed-SRC 此时仍能认证。不过，Fed-SRC 的认证过程大约需要消耗唯一校准项目数量 30 倍以上的流事件。适合对联邦学习、差分隐私、RAG 可靠性验证及形式化保证感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为联邦 RAG 系统提供了可证明的隐私保护输出质量认证，填补了隐私与可信 AI 交叉领域的空白。对需要在不共享原始数据的前提下保证生成内容准确性的场景（如医疗、金融）具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到联邦学习环境下的其他推理任务，为隐私敏感型 RAG 应用提供统计保证；有助于推动差分隐私与形式化验证在实际系统中的应用。

items.title: Capability-Routed Guard: Defending Large Reasoning Models Against Reasoning-Centric Jailbreaks
items.summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) expose a new safety failure mode: adversarial prompts can manipulate reasoning context, task decomposition, or capability interpretation so that harmful objectives are processed as legitimate reasoning steps. Existing safeguards, including safety reminders, external classifiers, and self-checking wrappers, are often brittle because they either inspect the adversarial prompt directly or ask the target model to perform additional safety reasoning on the same surface that attacks exploit. We introduce Capability-Routed Guard (CRG), a model-agnostic inference-time guardrail for closed-source LRMs, where defenders cannot inspect hidden reasoning traces or modify model weights. CRG reframes prompt defense as a capability-routing problem: a side-channel controller first constructs a trusted representation of the user's authorized task, active context, safety evidence, and capability-transfer risk, separating executable intent from untrusted reasoning context. This representation supports route-specific execution, allowing CRG to block high-risk requests, constrain ambiguous ones, and forward low-risk requests through trusted active context. Finally, CRG applies TraceCheck to verify consistency with the authorized task and invokes a restricted fallback to preserve utility for low-risk benign prompts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CRG effectively mitigates diverse reasoning-centric jailbreaks while preserving benign utility and avoiding common over-refusal issues. Further analysis shows that its components contribute complementary benefits, highlighting the importance of coordinated defense mechanisms for securing large reasoning models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）在将复杂任务分解为中间推理步骤时，暴露出一种新的安全失效模式：对抗性提示可操纵推理上下文、任务分解或能力解读，使有害目标被当作合法推理步骤处理。现有防护措施（如安全提醒、外部分类器、自检查包装器）通常较脆弱，因为它们要么直接检查对抗性提示，要么要求目标模型在同一被攻击的推理表面上执行额外安全推理。本文提出能力路由防护（Capability-Routed Guard, CRG），一种模型无关的推理时防护栏，专为无法检查隐藏推理轨迹或修改模型权重的闭源LRM设计。CRG将提示防御重构为能力路由问题：一个边信道控制器首先构建用户授权任务、活动上下文、安全证据和能力迁移风险的可信表示，将可执行意图与不可信的推理上下文分离。该表示支持路由特定执行，使CRG能够阻断高风险请求、约束模糊请求、并通过可信活动上下文转发低风险请求。最后，CRG应用TraceCheck验证与授权任务的一致性，并调用受限回退机制以保持低风险良性提示的效用。大量实验表明，CRG能有效缓解多种推理中心越狱攻击，同时保持良性效用并避免过度拒绝。进一步分析显示，其组件提供互补收益，凸显了协同防御机制对于保护大型推理模型的重要性。本文主要贡献包括：提出针对推理中心越狱的防御框架、设计模型无关的推理时防护架构、以及通过实验验证其有效性与可用性。适合安全研究人员、大模型平台防御工程师及关注LLM安全对齐的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 大型推理模型的推理中心越狱是新兴威胁，现有防御失效。CRG提出能力路由思路，不依赖模型内部，适用于闭源LRM，为抵御此类攻击提供了可落地的防护方向。

items.title: Can AI Write Compliant Code, and to What Extent? Evaluating SOC 2 Compliance of Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Claude Opus 5 Across Four Use Cases
items.summary: Software teams now delegate production code to language models, including code that provisions storage, handles credentials, and stores regulated data, so we asked whether a model applies the controls a SOC~2 program expects (encryption, restricted access, logging, retention) when nobody mentions security, and how much one sentence naming the standard changes the answer. We tested three frontier models (Claude Fable~5, Opus~4.8, and Opus~5) across four use cases (an S3 CLI, an authentication service, an RDS Terraform module, and a file-upload handler holding personal data), each generated once from a neutral task statement and once with a single SOC~2 sentence added, scoring all 24 outputs against binary rubrics mapped to specific Trust Services Criteria and hand-verifying every failure and flagged act. Unprompted conformance ran from 47\% to 88\% and tracked whether a control is part of how the code is normally written, so password hashing and \texttt{storage\_encrypted} appear unasked while S3 hardening calls, retention, and MFA hooks do not. The neutral prompt also shipped real vulnerabilities, including a reachable Werkzeug debugger allowing remote code execution, an unauthenticated download, and an endpoint returning every stored name and email, all scored clean by our first checklist, with a fourth defect passing because its value was computed by a conditional. One SOC~2 sentence moved every case to 86--100\%, worth 23 to 50 points, and removed every insecure construction, though controls outside the model's conception of the task survived it, including MFA hooks, cookie flags, and account lifecycle. Model choice mattered least, with same-generation models within one rubric item across all eight cells, and the pattern-matching scorer proved unreliable, disagreeing with semantic grading on 27 of 216 judgments and passing a real defect, so it needs replacing with semantic checks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统评估了前沿大语言模型在无人提示安全要求时编写代码的合规性，以及仅提及一次安全标准对结果的影响。研究选取三个模型（Claude Fable 5、Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Opus 5），在四个典型用例（S3 CLI、认证服务、RDS Terraform 模块、存储个人数据的文件上传处理程序）中，分别使用中性任务描述和追加一句“符合 SOC 2”的提示各生成一次代码，共得到 24 个输出。作者将 SOC 2 信任服务标准映射为二进制评分规则，并人工逐项验证所有失败与可疑行为。结果显示：无提示时合规率介于 47% 至 88%，且与“该控制是否为代码编写惯例”高度相关——密码哈希、存储加密等常见实践会被自动采用，而 S3 加固调用、日志留存、MFA 钩子等则缺失。中性提示生成的代码还包含真实可利用漏洞，包括可触达的 Werkzeug 调试器导致远程代码执行、未认证下载、返回全部姓名与邮箱的接口；其中第四个缺陷因条件语句计算而未被初版检查表识别。仅增加一句“符合 SOC 2”后，所有用例的合规率提升至 86%-100%，分数增长 23 至 50 分，且消除了所有不安全构造，但超出模型对任务概念范围的控制（如 MFA 钩子、Cookie 标志、账户生命周期）仍未被修正。模型间差异最小，同代模型在所有八个对比单元中仅相差一个评分项。论文还发现基于模式匹配的自动评分器不可靠，在 216 项判断中与语义判定有 27 处分歧，并漏过一个真实缺陷，因此需要以语义检查替代。研究贡献在于量化了安全提示对 LLM 生成代码合规性的效果，并揭示了当前评估方法的缺陷。适合 LLM 安全研究者、SOC 2 合规工程师及代码生成工具链设计者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了大模型默认输出中潜在的高危缺陷与合规缺失，证明一句安全提示即可大幅改善；同时指出自动化评分工具的脆弱性，对蓝队评估 AI 生成代码风险具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有利用 LLM 编写生产代码的软件团队；SOC 2 合规审计和 AI 辅助开发流程可能误判风险。

items.title: An Analysis of Architectural and Operational Dynamics of Phishkits in the Wild
items.summary: Phishing attacks have always been a favored vector for adversaries to defraud users, bypass modern defense mechanisms, and penetrate critical systems. Among all the elements contributing to the creation and deployment of successful phishing attacks, phishkits stand out as a crucial parameter. Phishkits often facilitate creating and deploying compelling phishing pages, implement evasion strategies, and establish and maintain backdoors with remote adversaries for exchanging leaked data. In this work, we performed an analysis of 1,300 modern phishkits collected from 2020 to 2023. We analyzed the architecture, source code, communication channels, and the nature of leaked data shared with adversaries. We identified mechanisms for dynamic redirection and attributing incoming web traffic as part of the evasion and cloaking mechanism. We also observed heavy reliance on current messaging services for exchanging stolen data with phishers. That said, our analysis shows that the number of phishkits with advanced functionalities is quite small. We identified 284 (21.8%) phishkits that did not use any form of evasion mechanism. We also observed that while there were differences in the implementation details of phishkits, the major components that keep phishing pages functional were very similar or even identical across kits. The level of code reuse and heavy reliance on known tricks to build pre-packaged phishing pages make a large number of cases predictable, which can potentially make the detection of these adversarial operations even easier at scale.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对2020年至2023年间收集的1300个真实世界中的钓鱼工具包（Phishkits）进行了深度分析，旨在揭示其架构和操作动态。钓鱼攻击一直是攻击者绕过现代防御、渗透关键系统的常用手段，而Phishkits在其中扮演了关键角色，它们通常用于快速生成具有迷惑性的钓鱼页面、执行逃避策略，并与远程攻击者建立后门以窃取数据。研究团队从架构设计、源代码实现、通信通道以及泄露数据的性质等多个维度对样本进行了剖析。他们识别出两类主要的逃避机制：动态重定向和针对来访流量的属性分析，用于伪装和辨别爬虫与真实受害者。同时，研究发现这些工具包高度依赖现有的即时通讯服务（如Telegram等）来传输窃取到的数据，而非使用传统C2基础设施。尽管存在这些高级功能，但分析表明，真正具备复杂功能的Phishkits占比很小，有284个（占21.8%）甚至没有任何逃避机制。此外，虽然各工具包在具体实现细节上存在差异，但维持钓鱼页面正常功能的核心组件高度相似甚至完全相同。这种高水平的代码复用和对已知技巧的依赖，使得大量钓鱼工具包的行为模式可预测，这为安全团队在大规模场景下自动检测和防御此类攻击提供了便利。该研究为理解现代Phishkits的演化提供了宝贵的数据支撑，并指出了防御方可以利用的共性弱点。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了Phishkits在真实世界中的共性与演化趋势，帮助安全团队利用代码复用和逃避机制薄弱点构建规模化检测，提升钓鱼防御的效率和自动化水平。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响钓鱼检测、威胁情报和应急响应领域。安全厂商可据此优化钓鱼URL检测模型，SOC可针对动态重定向和即时通讯外传数据的行为建立监控规则，从而更有效地发现和阻断钓鱼攻击。
detection_signals_zh: 动态重定向行为（如针对爬虫和真实用户分流）
与即时通讯服务（如Telegram等）的数据外传通信
多个Phishkit之间高度相似的代码特征或页面模板
部分Phishkit完全不存在任何逃避机制（如284个未伪装）
defense_advice_zh: 利用代码复用特征构建指纹库，实现大规模扫描和快速识别
对网络流量中与已知即时通讯服务域名的异常通信进行监控
针对动态重定向逻辑，模拟不同访问来源以暴露伪装行为
重视无逃避机制的Phishkit，它们通常更容易被传统URL过滤拦截
